功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • 仁济医院团队 Science 揭示成纤维细胞调控肠道免疫抗肠炎新机制
    Renji Team in Science Reveals How Fibroblasts Orchestrate Gut Immunity Against Colitis
    上海仁济医院周磊、林清霞团队在 Science 发表研究，阐明肠道成纤维细胞通过特定信号通路调控局部免疫反应、抑制肠道炎症的新机制。该发现为炎症性肠病等功能医学视角下的黏膜免疫失衡干预提供了新靶点，也为菌群-免疫-屏障轴的精准调节研究补充了关键环节。
    A team led by Zhou Lei and Lin Qingxia at Shanghai Renji Hospital published in Science a new mechanism whereby intestinal fibroblasts regulate local immune responses and restrain gut inflammation via specific signaling pathways. The finding offers fresh targets for mucosal immune imbalance in inflammatory bowel disease and enriches the microbiome-immunity-barrier axis in functional medicine research.
  • 工程益生菌化身“肿瘤药厂”：结肠癌小鼠模型肿瘤缩小 43%
    Engineered Probiotic Acts as a Tumor Drug Factory, Cutting Colorectal Tumors by 43% in Mice
    发表于 Science Translational Medicine 的研究将益生菌大肠杆菌 Nissle 1917 改造成肿瘤内定向“制药工厂”：细菌富集于肿瘤后原位生成 5-氟尿嘧啶，并叠加免疫激活与 PD-L1 阻断功能。小鼠实验中结肠肿瘤体积减少 43%，3/7 肿瘤完全消退，为活体微生物疗法联合化免治疗提供概念验证。
    A Science Translational Medicine study reprogrammed probiotic E. coli Nissle 1917 into an in-tumor drug factory: bacteria enriched in tumors locally convert 5-fluorocytosine into 5-fluorouracil while additionally stimulating immunity and blocking PD-L1. Colorectal tumors in mice shrank by 43%, with three of seven eliminated — a proof of concept for live biotherapeutics combined with chemoimmunotherapy.
  • VA 盲法 RCT 亚分析：FMT 治复发性艰难梭菌未改善生活质量
    VA Blinded RCT Subanalysis: FMT Fails to Improve Quality of Life in Recurrent C. difficile
    9 月上传于 Research Square 的预印本对 VA 安慰剂对照 FMT 随机试验进行生活质量亚分析：胶囊 FMT 组与安慰剂组的胃肠生活质量指数无显著差异，且该试验主结果同样未显示复发率获益。作者强调应将患者报告结局纳入 FMT 试验常规终点，提示不同制剂与递送方式的疗效差异需审慎解读。
    A September preprint on Research Square reports a quality-of-life subanalysis of the VA placebo-controlled FMT randomized trial: encapsulated FMT showed no significant difference from placebo on the GI Quality of Life Index, and the main trial likewise found no recurrence benefit. The authors urge patient-reported outcomes as standard FMT endpoints, cautioning that formulation and delivery may explain divergent results.
  • 国家卫健委答复强化糖尿病综合防治：营养标签新国标强制标示糖与饱和脂肪
    NHC Outlines Strengthened Diabetes Prevention: New Nutrition Label Rules Mandate Sugar and Saturated Fat Labeling
    国家卫健委在答复全国人大代表建议时系统介绍糖尿病防治进展：联合 14 部门印发防治行动实施方案提出 24 条措施；修订《预包装食品营养标签通则》将糖与饱和脂肪新增为强制标示项并增加儿童青少年提示语；在校园限制销售含糖饮料，强化三减三健与医防融合监测体系。
    Replying to a deputy's proposal, China's National Health Commission outlined diabetes prevention measures: a 24-point action plan with 14 ministries, revised nutrition labeling rules making sugar and saturated fat mandatory label items with youth-specific warnings, restrictions on sugary drinks in schools, and strengthened screening and integrated prevention-treatment monitoring.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • 北大韩敬东/陈嘉伟 Nature Aging：AI 锁定口腔“长寿菌”奈瑟氏菌
    Peking University Team in Nature Aging: AI Pinpoints Oral “Longevity Bacterium” Neisseria flavescens
    北京大学韩敬东、陈嘉伟团队在 Nature Aging 发表研究，用生成式多模态框架 AURORA 构建衰老时钟并对干预进行算术筛选，鉴定出口腔共生菌 Neisseria flavescens 为核心延寿菌：在线虫中延长寿命与健康span，老年小鼠补充热灭活菌可逆转血清代谢组、肝脏转录组与肠道菌群至更年轻状态，提示口腔微生物组是系统性衰老的被低估轴。
    Peking University's Han Jingdong and Chen Jiawei reported in Nature Aging that AURORA, a generative multi-modality framework for aging clocks and in silico intervention screening, identified oral commensal Neisseria flavescens as a geroprotective microbe: it extended lifespan and healthspan in C. elegans, and heat-killed N. flavescens in aged mice shifted serum metabolome, liver transcriptome and gut microbiome toward younger states — framing the oral microbiome as an underestimated axis of systemic aging.
  • 第五届中国基础医学发展大会首届衰老与健康研讨会：专家称“长寿药并不存在，逆龄是商业炒作”
    China's 5th Basic Medical Development Congress Debuts Aging & Health Symposium: “No Longevity Pills — Reversal Claims Are Hype”
    中国医学科学院北京协和医学院主办的第五届中国基础医学发展大会暨首届衰老与健康研讨会上，西湖大学付向东提出衰老“耗竭理论”，北京大学韩敬东展示整合 58 万样本的生成式 AI 衰老时钟。与会专家普遍认为基于现有研究“长寿药”并不存在，逆龄概念属商业炒作，呼吁把基础研究与临床需求结合，服务健康老龄化。
    At the 5th China Basic Medical Development Congress and first Aging & Health Symposium hosted by the Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences, Fu Xiangdong of Westlake University proposed a “resource exhaustion” theory of aging, while Peking University's Han Jingdong presented generative AI aging clocks trained on 580,000 samples. Experts agreed that no true “longevity pill” exists yet, called anti-aging reversal claims commercial hype, and urged tighter basic research-clinical integration.
  • 《基因组精神病学》系统综述：警惕衰老测量指标混淆“治病”与“抗衰”
    Genomic Psychiatry Review Warns Aging Metrics May Confuse Disease Treatment With Slower Aging
    发表于《基因组精神病学》的系统性综述指出，广泛使用的衰老测量方法——表观遗传时钟、虚弱指数与衰老标志物框架——可能混淆真正的衰老减缓与疾病特异性改善；不同物种主要死因差异巨大，通过延缓癌症延长小鼠寿命不等于减缓多系统衰退。作者呼吁区分基线效应与速率效应，建立跨组织、跨物种的标准化表型评估体系。
    A systematic review in Genomic Psychiatry argues that widely used aging metrics — epigenetic clocks, frailty indices and hallmark frameworks — may confound genuine slowing of aging with disease-specific improvement. Because leading causes of death differ vastly across species, extending mouse lifespan by delaying cancer is not equivalent to slowing multisystem decline. The authors call for separating baseline from rate effects and standardized cross-tissue, cross-species phenotyping.
  • Nature Metabolism：肌肉干细胞靠 PFKM 代谢“开关”先修复后生长
    Nature Metabolism: Muscle Stem Cells Use a PFKM Metabolic Switch to Repair Before They Grow
    加州大学尔湾分校团队在 Nature Metabolism 揭示肌肉干细胞应对压力的代谢时序：通过 PFKM 酶暂时减缓能量生产，将葡萄糖转向抗氧化修复，完成后再重启能量生产构建肌纤维。该机制为年龄增长、损伤及 GLP-1 减重药物导致的肌肉流失干预提供了代谢“构建块”补充的新思路。
    UC Irvine researchers reported in Nature Metabolism that muscle stem cells respond to stress with a metabolic timing mechanism: the enzyme PFKM temporarily dials down energy production to divert glucose toward antioxidant repair, then restarts energy production to build new fibers. The finding suggests metabolic “building block” supplementation strategies against muscle loss from aging, injury and GLP-1 weight-loss drugs.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • Nutrition Reviews 荟萃：基因导向膳食建议仅多减重 0.52 公斤
    Nutrition Reviews Meta-Analysis: Genetics-Based Diet Advice Adds Just 0.52 kg Weight Loss
    9 月 24 日发表于 Nutrition Reviews 的荟萃分析汇总 8 项随机对照试验：与常规膳食建议相比，基于基因型的个性化营养与生活方式建议仅额外减重 0.52 公斤、BMI 多降 0.30，体脂率无显著差异。结果显示基因导向营养的群体平均获益微小，提示基因检测应作为个性化营养的参考数据点而非“捷径”。
    A meta-analysis published September 24 in Nutrition Reviews pooled 8 randomized trials: genetics-based personalized nutrition and lifestyle advice produced only 0.52 kg extra weight loss and 0.30 BMI reduction versus standard advice, with no change in body fat percentage. The average population benefit is tiny, suggesting genetic testing should serve as one data point in precision nutrition rather than a shortcut.
  • AJKD RCT：植物蛋白主导饮食可降低晚期 CKD 患者尿毒症毒素
    AJKD RCT: Normoproteic Plant-Dominant Diets Lower Uremic Toxins in Advanced CKD
    发表于 American Journal of Kidney Diseases 的随机对照试验显示，在保持正常蛋白摄入的前提下采用植物蛋白为主的饮食，可通过靶向肠道菌群显著降低晚期慢性肾病患者的尿毒症毒素水平。研究为“营养干预调节肠菌、减轻肾脏负担”的精准营养路径提供了高级别临床证据。
    A randomized controlled trial in the American Journal of Kidney Diseases showed that a normoproteic, plant-dominant diet significantly reduced uremic toxin levels in patients with advanced chronic kidney disease by targeting the gut microbiota. The results provide high-level clinical evidence for precision nutrition strategies that modulate gut microbes to ease renal burden.
  • JAMA Psychiatry：抑郁症患者限制超加工食品的非药物干预初见成效
    JAMA Psychiatry: Cutting Ultra-Processed Foods Shows Early Promise for Depression
    JAMA Psychiatry 发表的短篇研究探讨从抑郁症患者饮食中移除超加工食品的非药物干预路径，初步结果显示可行性并在情绪结局上初见成效。研究将饮食质量作为精神健康的可调节靶点，为“营养精神病学”与菌群-肠-脑轴导向的个体化膳食干预积累了早期证据。
    A short article in JAMA Psychiatry explored removing ultra-processed foods from the diets of patients with depression as a non-pharmacological intervention. Early results suggest feasibility and promising mood outcomes, positioning diet quality as a modifiable target in psychiatric care and adding early evidence for nutritional psychiatry and microbiome-gut-brain-directed personalized dietary intervention.
  • Frontiers 综述：饮食、生活方式与宿主因素如何塑造菌群-宿主互作的个体差异
    Frontiers Review: Dietary, Lifestyle and Host Determinants of Microbiota-Host Interactions
    墨西哥锡那罗亚自治大学团队 9 月 25 日接收于 Frontiers in Microbiomes 的叙述性综述系统梳理膳食模式、食物成分、运动、睡眠与昼夜节律、衰老及药物暴露对肠道菌群组成与功能的调节作用，强调个体间差异是核心特征，提出整合菌群数据与宿主及环境特征的个性化营养框架，并呼吁纵向研究与多组学验证。
    A narrative review from Universidad Autónoma de Sinaloa, accepted September 25 in Frontiers in Microbiomes, maps how dietary patterns, food components, exercise, sleep and circadian rhythms, aging and medication exposure shape gut microbial composition and function. Highlighting interindividual variability as the central feature, it proposes a personalized nutrition framework integrating microbiome, host and environmental data, and calls for longitudinal multi-omics validation.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • Balchem 维生素 K2 研究显示与冠脉钙化进展放缓 21% 相关
    Balchem's Vitamin K2 Linked to 21% Slower Coronary Calcium Progression
    NutraIngredients 9 月 25 日报道，Balchem 公司 K2VITAL DELTA 型维生素 K2（MK-7）的长期研究数据显示，补充与冠状动脉钙化（CAC）进展速度放缓 21% 相关，提示维生素 K2 可能通过激活基质 Gla 蛋白引导钙沉积、减少血管钙化，为心血管长期健康管理提供具成本效益的营养干预线索，仍需更大型硬终点试验确认。
    NutraIngredients reported on September 25 that long-term data on Balchem's K2VITAL DELTA vitamin K2 (MK-7) link supplementation with 21% slower coronary artery calcium (CAC) progression. The findings suggest K2 may direct calcium deposition via matrix Gla protein activation and reduce vascular calcification, hinting at a cost-effective nutritional lever for long-term cardiovascular health — pending confirmation in larger hard-endpoint trials.
  • 研究：社交媒体补剂营销误导信息泛滥
    Social Media Rife With Misleading Supplement Marketing, Researchers Find
    NutraIngredients 9 月 25 日报道的新研究系统审查社交媒体上的膳食补剂营销内容，发现夸大功效、未经证实健康声称与隐晦广告普遍存在，缺乏充分科学依据的“种草”内容大量触达消费者。研究者呼吁平台加强审核、行业提升声称实证标准，也为功能医学与营养从业者做科学传播提供警示样本。
    New research covered by NutraIngredients on September 25 systematically reviewed dietary supplement marketing on social media and found pervasive exaggerated efficacy claims, unsubstantiated health statements and covert advertising reaching consumers at scale without adequate scientific backing. The authors call for stronger platform moderation and higher substantiation standards — a caution for practitioners doing science communication in nutrition and functional medicine.
  • Alice Mushrooms 案件检验成分实证边界：功能性蘑菇品牌面临声称审查
    Alice Mushrooms Case Tests the Limits of Ingredient Substantiation
    NutraIngredients 9 月 25 日分析 Alice Mushrooms 功能性蘑菇产品相关案件，聚焦“成品证据”与“原料推断证据”的边界：品牌引用成分研究支持终端产品声称是否充分，正成为功能性蘑菇、适应原等热门品类的监管与诉讼焦点，为补剂行业标注实证与合规策略敲响警钟。
    A September 25 NutraIngredients analysis of the Alice Mushrooms functional mushroom case examines the boundary between finished-product evidence and ingredient-level inference: whether citing ingredient studies sufficiently supports end-product claims is becoming a regulatory and litigation flashpoint for mushrooms and adaptogens — a warning shot for supplement substantiation and compliance strategy.
  • NutraIngredients 趋势追踪：AI 双刃剑与健康span新品集中发布
    NutraIngredients Trend Tracker: AI's Pros and Cons and a Wave of Healthspan Launches
    NutraIngredients 9 月 25 日趋势追踪栏目盘点：AI 正同时赋能补剂行业的个性化推荐与新品研发，也带来虚假营销与过度承诺风险；健康span（健康寿命）导向的多成分组合新品集中上市，品牌更多把细胞健康科学嵌入整体健康老龄化产品组合，反映“从延寿叙事转向循证日常产品”的行业转变。
    NutraIngredients' September 25 trend tracker rounds up how AI is simultaneously powering personalization and product development in supplements while amplifying misinformation and overclaiming risks; healthspan-oriented multi-ingredient launches are clustering as brands fold cellular-health science into broader healthy-aging portfolios — a shift from longevity narratives toward evidence-based everyday products.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • 48 位专家共议慢病早期预防：《“十保九减八防”专家共识》发布
    48-Expert Consensus Issued: “Ten Keeps, Nine Reductions, Eight Preventions” for Early Chronic Disease Prevention
    国家科技重大专项项目组牵头、48 位多学科专家共同制定的《面向个体健康行为促进的慢性病早期预防专家共识》近日在《中国慢性病预防与控制》发表，提出保持十种健康生活方式、减少九类风险因素、防止八项相关侵害的系统化框架，覆盖饮食、运动、睡眠、体重、疫苗接种与新技术合理使用等，为成年居民提供普适化健康行为处方。
    A consensus on early chronic disease prevention, drafted by a national major science program team with 48 multidisciplinary experts and published in the Chinese Journal of Prevention and Control of Chronic Diseases, sets out a systematic framework of ten healthy lifestyle behaviors, nine risk-factor reductions and eight harm preventions — spanning diet, exercise, sleep, weight, vaccination and proper use of health devices — as a universal behavioral prescription for adults.
  • 贵州 68 家三级公立综合医院健康体重管理门诊全覆盖，累计接诊超 6 万人次
    Guizhou Achieves Full Coverage of Weight-Management Clinics Across 68 Tertiary Public Hospitals
    据贵州省卫健委消息，全省 68 家三级公立综合医院已全部设置健康体重管理门诊，截至 8 月底累计接诊 6 万余人次。当地依托临床营养科、内分泌科、儿科等多学科资源并注重中西医协同，集中推进体重管理门诊建设，为“体重管理年”从政策到基层落地提供了省级样板。
    Guizhou's health commission says all 68 tertiary public hospitals in the province now run health weight-management clinics, with over 60,000 visits logged by the end of August. Built on multidisciplinary resources — clinical nutrition, endocrinology and pediatrics — with emphasis on integrated Chinese-Western medicine, the program offers a provincial model for taking national weight-management policy to the grassroots.
  • PATHFINDER 2 前瞻研究：多癌早检血液测试覆盖 17 种癌，阳性预测值 60.3%
    PATHFINDER 2: Multi-Cancer Blood Test Detects 17 Cancer Types With 60.3% Positive Predictive Value
    发表于 Nature Medicine 的前瞻性 PATHFINDER 2 研究纳入 35,878 名 50 岁以上成人：多癌早检（MCED）血液测试在 32,007 人主分析中识别 287 例阳性，阳性预测值 60.3%、特异性 99.64%，检出癌种中 72.8% 目前无常规筛查推荐，53% 为 I-II 期。研究者强调该测试应作为现有筛查的补充而非替代。
    The prospective PATHFINDER 2 study published in Nature Medicine enrolled 35,878 adults aged 50 and older: the multi-cancer early detection (MCED) blood test flagged 287 positive results among 32,007 in the primary analysis, with a 60.3% positive predictive value and 99.64% specificity; 72.8% of detected cancers currently have no routine screening, and 53% were stage I-II. Researchers stress it should complement, not replace, existing screening.
  • 三部门部署中秋国庆及秋冬季重点传染病防治：强化智能监测预警
    Three Agencies Deploy Pre-Holiday and Autumn-Winter Infectious Disease Prevention With Smart Surveillance
    9 月 24 日国家疾控局联合国家卫健委、国家中医药局召开全国视频会议，部署中秋国庆假期前后及秋冬季重点传染病防治：要求加强多渠道监测、用好国家传染病智能监测预警前置软件，健全入境疑似病例闭环处置机制，及时处置蚊媒与人畜共患病聚集性疫情，并广泛开展爱国卫生运动与健康科普。
    On September 24 the National Disease Control and Prevention Administration, with the National Health Commission and National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine, held a national video meeting on infectious disease control around the Mid-Autumn and National Day holidays and autumn-winter season — strengthening multi-channel surveillance with the national intelligent early-warning software, closed-loop handling of imported suspected cases, prompt response to vector-borne and zoonotic clusters, and broad health education.

功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • Genetic Analysis 获加拿大专利：用肠道菌群伴随诊断筛选 IBS 菌群移植应答者
    Genetic Analysis Granted Canadian Patent for Microbiome Companion Diagnostic Predicting FMT Response in IBS
    挪威分子诊断公司 Genetic Analysis 宣布其加拿大专利申请获准授权，保护一种体外诊断方法：通过分析肠道菌群组成识别特定细菌模式，筛选更可能对粪菌移植（FMT）治疗产生应答的肠易激综合征（IBS）患者。IBS 影响全球约 5%-10% 人群，约 70% 患者存在菌群失调，该专利将菌群特征从描述失调升级为指导治疗选择，专利保护期延至 2037 年，标志着菌群伴随诊断向个体化治疗决策迈出实质一步。
    Norwegian molecular diagnostics company Genetic Analysis announced that its Canadian patent application has been allowed, protecting an in vitro diagnostic method that analyzes gut microbiota composition to identify bacterial patterns predicting which irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) patients are more likely to respond to fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT). IBS affects an estimated 5-10% of the global population and about 70% of patients show dysbiosis. The patent elevates microbiota signatures from describing dysbiosis to guiding treatment selection, with protection extending to 2037 — a substantive step toward individualized treatment decisions in microbiome-based companion diagnostics.
  • Cell Reports Medicine：FMT 一线治疗免疫检查点抑制剂相关腹泻/结肠炎，13 例中 10 例临床响应
    Cell Reports Medicine: First-line FMT for Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor-Induced Diarrhea and Colitis Achieves Response in 10 of 13 Patients
    美国德州大学 MD 安德森癌症中心团队在 Cell Reports Medicine 发表粪菌移植（FMT）一线治疗免疫检查点抑制剂相关腹泻和结肠炎（IMDC）的临床数据：13 例患者中 10 例（76.9%）达到临床响应，临床改善中位时间仅 1.5 天；应答者 FMT 后肠道微生物多样性增加，浆细胞、多种 T 细胞亚群等免疫细胞丰度下降。研究提示 FMT 有望从难治性结肠炎的补救方案前移为一线干预选项。
    Researchers at the University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center published clinical data in Cell Reports Medicine on first-line fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) for immune checkpoint inhibitor-mediated diarrhea and colitis (IMDC): 10 of 13 patients (76.9%) achieved clinical response, with a median time to improvement of just 1.5 days. Responders showed increased gut microbial diversity after FMT and reductions in plasma cells and multiple T-cell subsets. The findings suggest FMT could move from a salvage option for refractory colitis toward first-line intervention.
  • 陕西师大韩彦慧团队 Gut Microbes：真菌囊泡重塑益生菌囊泡，助力肠道抗炎
    Gut Microbes: Fungal Extracellular Vesicles Reshape Lactobacillus rhamnosus Vesicles to Resolve Intestinal Inflammation
    陕西师范大学韩彦慧团队在 Gut Microbes（IF 15.3）发表研究，发现真菌细胞外囊泡可重塑鼠李糖乳杆菌的细菌外囊泡，使其增强宿主溶酶体稳态并消退肠道炎症。该工作提示微生物组之间通过囊泡介导的跨界“对话”可以改变益生菌的功能表型，为通过后生元与囊泡工程设计更精准的微生态干预提供了新机制视角，也拓展了功能医学肠道干预的工具箱。
    A team led by Han Yanhui at Shaanxi Normal University reported in Gut Microbes that fungal extracellular vesicles can reshape bacterial membrane vesicles of Lactobacillus rhamnosus, enhancing host lysosomal homeostasis and resolving intestinal inflammation. The work suggests cross-kingdom vesicle-mediated “dialogue” within the microbiome can alter probiotic functional phenotypes, offering a new mechanistic angle for designing more precise postbiotic and vesicle-engineered interventions and expanding the gut-focused toolkit of functional medicine.
  • 第二届 RIKEN–ISM Targeting Microbiota 大会东京启幕：65 场报告聚焦从关联到因果再到精准干预
    2nd RIKEN–ISM Targeting Microbiota 2026 Opens in Tokyo: 65 Communications on Moving from Association to Causality and Precision Intervention
    9 月 24-25 日，第二届 RIKEN–ISM Targeting Microbiota 2026 在东京大学举行，来自 11 个国家的 65 场学术报告覆盖宿主-菌群互作、微生物代谢物、免疫、线粒体、单细胞与株水平方法、精准治疗等前沿方向。贯穿大会的核心之问是：如何从关联走向因果、再从因果走向精准干预。会议提供线上参与通道，为亚洲微生态临床转化研究搭建了重要国际对话平台。
    On September 24-25, the 2nd RIKEN–ISM Targeting Microbiota 2026 convened at the University of Tokyo, featuring 65 scientific communications from 11 countries covering host-microbiota interactions, microbial metabolites, immunity, mitochondria, single-cell and strain-level approaches, and precision therapeutics. The running question throughout the meeting: how to move from association to causality — and from causality to precise intervention. Online participation was available, making the event a key international platform for clinical translation of microbiome research in Asia.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • 局部衰老细胞清除药物逆转小鼠皮肤衰老并大幅加速伤口愈合
    Topical Senolytic Drug Reverses Skin Aging and Dramatically Speeds Wound Healing in Older Mice
    ScienceDaily 报道，一种可清除衰老、受损细胞的局部外用药物帮助老年小鼠皮肤伤口显著加快愈合。治疗似乎重新激活了涉及炎症调控、胶原合成与新血管生成的修复通路，提示senolytic 策略不仅可延缓皮肤老化，还有望用于改善老年人慢性创面、压疮等临床难题。该研究为局部递送的抗衰老干预提供了器官特异性转化范例。
    ScienceDaily reports that a topical drug removing senescent, damaged cells helped older mice heal skin wounds significantly faster. The treatment appeared to reactivate repair pathways involved in inflammation resolution, collagen production and new blood vessel formation, suggesting senolytic strategies may not only slow skin aging but also address clinical problems such as chronic wounds and pressure ulcers in older adults — an organ-specific translational model for locally delivered anti-aging interventions.
  • 德国老年医学会警告商业长寿声明缺乏人体证据，法兰克福大会将辩论“衰老是否是疾病”
    German Geriatrics Society Warns Commercial Longevity Claims Lack Human Evidence as Frankfurt Congress Prepares 'Is Aging a Disease?' Debate
    9 月 23-26 日约 1000 名老年医学专家齐聚法兰克福。德国老年医学会主席 Michael Denkinger 会前指出，市售“组织年轻化”肽类等长寿产品的证据仍停留在动物实验，“目前没有任何产品被证明能让人活得更长”；他反对将正常衰老病理化为疾病，同时强调规律运动、均衡饮食、戒烟限酒、定期体检与社会参与才是有临床研究支撑的健康衰老基石。9 月 26 日大会专设“衰老是否是疾病”辩论专场。
    About 1,000 geriatric specialists gathered in Frankfurt on September 23-26. Ahead of the congress, German Geriatrics Society president Michael Denkinger noted that evidence for commercial longevity products such as tissue-rejuvenating peptides remains limited to animal testing — 'there is no product that has shown that it makes humans live longer' — and rejected pathologizing normal aging, while stressing that regular activity, balanced diet, avoiding tobacco and alcohol, checkups and social engagement remain the evidence-based core of healthy aging. A dedicated session titled 'Is aging a disease?' is scheduled for September 26.
  • 2026 智慧医学与创新发展大会：6 项主动健康与衰老医学团体标准启动
    2026 Smart Medicine and Innovation Development Congress Launches Six Group Standards on Proactive Health and Clinical Aging Medicine
    9 月 18-20 日，2026 智慧医学与创新发展大会在深圳光明区召开，北京老年医院承办平行会议“第三届主动健康与临床衰老医学会议”。大会启动 6 项主动健康与衰老医学团体标准，为我国主动健康与衰老医学干预的标准化建设提供支撑；北京老年医院副院长刘小鹏作《人工智能驱动的未来医学革命——“主动健康”医学范式探究与实践路径》主旨报告，并与中关村生命健康产业公司签约共建“医学成果转化促进中心”。
    On September 18-20, the 2026 Smart Medicine and Innovation Development Congress convened in Guangming, Shenzhen, with Beijing Geriatric Hospital hosting the parallel '3rd Conference on Proactive Health and Clinical Aging Medicine.' Six group standards on proactive health and aging medicine were officially launched to support standardization of aging interventions in China. Liu Xiaopeng, vice president of the hospital, delivered a keynote on AI-driven proactive health paradigms, and a strategic agreement was signed to jointly build a Medical Achievement Translation Promotion Center with Zhongguancun Life and Health Industry.
  • 和祐国际医院集团长寿抗衰中心正式开业：四阶式服务+十大抗衰专项
    Heyou International Hospital Group Opens Longevity and Anti-Aging Center with Four-Stage Service Model and Ten Anti-Aging Programs
    9 月 22 日，和祐国际医院集团长寿抗衰中心在佛山正式开业。中心以健康管理为本，打造“查状态、防意外、调功能、抗衰老”四阶式服务内涵，围绕生物年龄检测、免疫平衡、脑力维护、代谢年轻化等十大抗衰专项建立健康画像与个体化长寿管理方案；专家矩阵覆盖抗衰医学、心血管、免疫、脑科学、功能医学、再生医学与数智化中医等领域，体现长寿医学正加速从概念走向医疗机构的实体化服务闭环。
    On September 22, the Longevity and Anti-Aging Center of Heyou International Hospital Group officially opened in Foshan. Anchored in health management, the center offers a four-stage service model — assess status, prevent emergencies, restore function, counter aging — and builds individualized longevity plans around ten anti-aging programs including biological age testing, immune balance, brain maintenance and metabolic rejuvenation. Its expert matrix spans anti-aging medicine, cardiology, immunology, brain science, functional medicine, regenerative medicine and digital TCM, reflecting how longevity medicine is moving from concept to institutionalized clinical service loops.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • iMeta：肠道屎肠球菌源亮氨酸介导膳食纤维的抗肥胖效应
    iMeta: Gut Enterococcus faecium-Derived Leucic Acid Mediates the Anti-Obesity Effect of Dietary Fiber
    刘洪涛团队在 iMeta（IF 44.4）发表研究，揭示膳食纤维的抗肥胖效应可由肠道屎肠球菌源性亮氨酸（leucic acid）介导。该发现把“吃纤维→菌群代谢→宿主获益”的经典链条推进到具体菌株-具体代谢物-具体效应的因果层面，为以菌群代谢物为靶点的精准营养干预提供了新的分子接口，也提示相同膳食纤维在不同肠道菌群背景下的减重效果可能存在个体差异。
    A team led by Liu Hongtao reported in iMeta (IF 44.4) that the anti-obesity effect of dietary fiber can be mediated by Enterococcus faecium-derived leucic acid from the gut. The finding pushes the classic chain of 'fiber intake → microbial metabolism → host benefit' down to the causal level of a specific strain, a specific metabolite and a specific effect, providing a new molecular interface for microbiome-targeted precision nutrition and suggesting that responses to the same fiber may vary across individual gut microbiome backgrounds.
  • Elixinol Wellness 收购个性化营养公司 Vitable，全球个性化健康赛道持续升温
    Elixinol Wellness to Acquire Personalized Nutrition Firm Vitable Amid Global Interest in Personalized Health
    NutraIngredients 报道，Elixinol Wellness 宣布计划收购澳大利亚个性化营养公司 Vitable，正值全球资本市场对个性化健康兴趣升温之际。个性化营养通过问卷、检测与算法为用户定制补充剂组合，正在从初创赛道进入主流营养企业并购清单。该交易显示“检测-定制-订阅”模式商业模型获验证，也预示精准营养的行业整合与渠道规模化竞争将加剧。
    NutraIngredients reports that Elixinol Wellness announced plans to acquire Australian personalized nutrition firm Vitable, amid growing global capital-market interest in personalized health. Personalized nutrition — which customizes supplement regimens via questionnaires, testing and algorithms — is moving from a startup niche onto mainstream nutraceutical M&A lists. The deal validates the 'assess-customize-subscribe' business model and signals intensifying industry consolidation and scale competition in precision nutrition channels.
  • NutraIngredients 观点：甜菜根与高血压——一个充满错误信息的世界
    NutraIngredients Opinion: Beets and Hypertension — A World of Disinformation
    Kaiviti Consulting 总裁 Mark Miller 博士在 NutraIngredients 发表专栏，指出围绕甜菜根与硝酸盐降血压的网络传播充斥夸大、断章取义与错误信息：剂量、急性与慢性效应、不同人群反应差异常被混为一谈。文章呼吁行业以机制与剂量学证据为基础做负责任的科学传播，为精准营养时代“成分-效应-人群”三层证据链的公众沟通提供了警示样本。
    In a NutraIngredients opinion column, Dr. Mark Miller, president of Kaiviti Consulting, argues that online communication around beets and nitrate-mediated blood pressure reduction is rife with exaggeration, out-of-context claims and disinformation — doses, acute versus chronic effects and inter-individual variability are routinely conflated. The piece calls for responsible science communication grounded in mechanism and dosing evidence, serving as a cautionary example of how the ingredient-effect-population evidence chain should be conveyed in the precision nutrition era.
  • MDPI Nutrients 综述：营养基因组学-菌群-表观基因组轴作为癌症预防精准营养的框架
    MDPI Nutrients Review: The Nutrigenomics–Microbiome–Epigenome Axis as a Framework for Precision Nutrition in Cancer Prevention
    MDPI Nutrients 刊发综述，系统梳理甲基供体、多酚、短链脂肪酸、Ω-3 等膳食因子如何通过 DNA 甲基转移酶与组蛋白去乙酰化酶调节表观基因组，并提出“营养基因组学-菌群-表观基因组轴”概念框架：菌群衍生代谢物影响宿主染色质结构与基因表达。作者同时强调，当前人体证据对“表观基因组可被饮食改变”的支持强于对“临床获益”的支持，该框架应视为产生假设的研究工具而非成熟临床路径。
    A review in MDPI Nutrients systematically maps how dietary factors — methyl donors, polyphenols, short-chain fatty acids and omega-3s — modulate the epigenome via DNA methyltransferases and histone deacetylases, and proposes the 'Nutrigenomics–Microbiome–Epigenome Axis' framework in which microbiota-derived metabolites shape host chromatin architecture and gene expression. The authors stress that human evidence supports biological responsiveness of the epigenome to diet more strongly than clinical utility, positioning the framework as hypothesis-generating rather than a validated clinical pathway.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • 不止于激素模拟：重新审视植物雌激素在绝经后健康中的多重获益
    More Than Hormone Mimicry: Rethinking the Broader Benefits of Phytoestrogens in Post-Menopause
    NutraIngredients 深度文章指出，植物雌激素的绝经后健康获益远不止“模拟激素”一条路径：其代谢产物（如雌马酚）依赖个体肠道菌群组成，可经由非受体介导途径影响骨代谢、心血管与认知等多个系统。文章提示，菌群代谢能力差异或是既往干预研究结果不一的关键解释，未来植物雌激素补充策略应纳入菌群分型，为围绝经期女性精准补剂设计提供新依据。
    A NutraIngredients deep-dive argues that the post-menopausal benefits of phytoestrogens extend well beyond 'hormone mimicry': their metabolites (such as equol) depend on individual gut microbiome composition and can act through non-receptor-mediated pathways influencing bone, cardiovascular and cognitive health. Inter-individual differences in microbial metabolism may explain inconsistent intervention results, and future phytoestrogen supplementation strategies should incorporate microbiome profiling — a new basis for designing precision supplements for perimenopausal and postmenopausal women.
  • 橄榄工业副产物展现天然抗氧化剂来源潜力
    Olive Industry By-Products Show Potential as Natural Antioxidant Sources
    NutraIngredients 报道，橄榄油加工产生的大量果渣、叶片与废水中富含羟基酪醇、橄榄苦苷等多酚类抗氧化物，正被重新定位为天然抗氧化剂原料来源。提取技术进步使副产物中的活性成分回收率与纯度显著提升，既回应了市场对清洁标签天然抗氧化方案的需求，也为榨油产业链提供了循环经济增值路径，“从废料到成分”成为补剂原料创新的重要方向。
    NutraIngredients reports that the pomace, leaves and wastewater generated by olive oil processing are rich in hydroxytyrosol, oleuropein and other polyphenolic antioxidants, and are being repositioned as natural antioxidant ingredient sources. Advances in extraction have significantly improved recovery and purity of active compounds from by-products, responding to clean-label demand for natural antioxidant solutions while adding circular-economy value to the olive oil chain — 'from waste to ingredient' is emerging as a key direction in supplement raw-material innovation.
  • 新西兰拟允许健康补剂出口采用治疗性声称，业界表示支持
    New Zealand Proposes to Allow Therapeutic Claims for Health Supplement Exports, Industry Voices Support
    新西兰政府提出新规，拟允许出口的健康补剂产品在符合进口目的地法规的前提下使用治疗性声称，业界普遍表达支持。支持者认为此举将提升新西兰补剂在全球市场的竞争力与合规确定性；评论同时强调，声称必须以科学证据与目标市场批准为前提。该动议与全球补剂监管分化趋势并行，为出口型营养企业提供了观察“证据分级+市场适配”监管思路的新样本。
    The New Zealand government has proposed new rules allowing exported health supplements to carry therapeutic claims, provided they comply with the regulations of destination markets — a move broadly welcomed by industry. Supporters say it would boost the competitiveness and regulatory certainty of New Zealand supplements globally, while commentators stress that claims must rest on scientific evidence and destination-market approval. The proposal, aligned with the global trend of divergent supplement regulation, offers export-oriented nutraceutical firms a new case study in 'evidence grading plus market-fit' regulatory thinking.
  • 女性健康热潮将科学传播置于聚光灯下
    Women's Health Boom Puts Science Communication Under the Microscope
    NutraIngredients 分析指出，随着女性健康成为补剂行业增长最快的品类之一，社交媒体上围绕围绝经期、激素与补剂的科学传播质量参差不齐，夸大与误读并存。文章呼吁品牌在品类红利期把证据透明度与专业审核机制置于营销增长之前，建立可追溯的声称审核流程；科学传播能力正成为女性健康赛道区别于流量竞争的核心壁垒。
    A NutraIngredients analysis notes that as women's health becomes one of the fastest-growing supplement categories, the quality of social-media science communication around perimenopause, hormones and supplements is highly uneven, mixing exaggeration with misreading. The piece urges brands, during this category boom, to put evidence transparency and professional review ahead of marketing growth by establishing traceable claim-approval processes. Science communication capability is becoming the core differentiator in the women's health category, beyond traffic-driven competition.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • 欧洲心脏杂志 SELECT 分析：司美格鲁肽心血管获益仅约半数可由风险因素改善解释
    European Heart Journal SELECT Analysis: Only About Half of Semaglutide's Cardiovascular Benefit Explained by Risk-Factor Changes
    发表于《欧洲心脏杂志》的 SELECT 试验事后分析显示：在 17,604 名超重/肥胖受试者中，司美格鲁肽组严重心血管事件风险降低约 20%，但体重、腰围、血压、血脂、炎症与肾功能等已知风险因素的改善合计仅能解释其中约一半获益。爱丁堡大学 Helen Colhoun 团队认为，剩余效应可能来自未被充分捕捉的抗炎作用或对心肌、血管内皮的直接作用，司美格鲁肽应被视为心血管疾病减险药物而非单纯减重药。
    A post-hoc analysis of the SELECT trial published in the European Heart Journal shows that among 17,604 participants with overweight or obesity, semaglutide reduced serious cardiovascular events by about 20%, yet improvements in known risk factors — weight, waist circumference, blood pressure, lipids, inflammation and kidney function — together explained no more than half of the benefit. Helen Colhoun's team at the University of Edinburgh suggests the remaining effect may arise from anti-inflammatory actions or direct effects on myocardium and vascular endothelium, concluding semaglutide should be considered a cardiovascular risk-reduction drug, not merely a weight-loss drug.
  • 2026 医学前沿创新大会在京召开：发布 15 项行业标准，老年医学迈向整体健康管理
    2026 Medical Frontier Innovation Congress Opens in Beijing: 15 Industry Standards Released as Geriatric Medicine Shifts to Holistic Health Management
    北京医院（国家老年医学中心）联合中国器官移植发展基金会主办的 2026 医学前沿创新大会在北京召开，集中展示我国老年医学与医学前沿创新成果，发布 15 项行业标准、诊疗指南及专家共识，设心血管、内分泌代谢、衰老标志物及干预、健康体重管理等 11 个分会场。会议提出老年医学正从“单病诊治”走向“整体健康管理”、从“被动治疗”走向“主动健康”、从“经验医学”走向“数智驱动”的范式转型。
    The 2026 Medical Frontier Innovation Congress, hosted by Beijing Hospital (National Center of Gerontology) with the China Organ Transplantation Development Foundation, convened in Beijing, showcasing national innovation in geriatric medicine and releasing 15 industry standards, clinical guidelines and expert consensus across 11 tracks including cardiovascular care, endocrine-metabolic disease, aging biomarkers and interventions, and healthy weight management. The congress framed a paradigm shift for geriatric medicine: from single-disease treatment to holistic health management, from passive care to proactive health, and from empirical medicine to data-driven practice.
  • 脑成像研究发现长新冠疲劳与脑雾的可能原因：多巴胺神经元受损
    Brain Scans Reveal a Possible Cause of Long COVID Fatigue and Brain Fog: Damage to Dopamine-Releasing Neurons
    ScienceDaily 报道，研究人员通过脑成像获得证据提示，长新冠可能损伤大脑中释放多巴胺的神经元，从而解释患者持续的疲劳、动力低下、动作迟缓与记忆困难等症状。这一发现将长新冠从功能性主诉推向可测量的神经机制层面，为开发针对多巴胺通路的诊断标志物与治疗策略提供了方向，也为慢性疲劳相关健康管理的评估体系提供了新参照。
    ScienceDaily reports that researchers have found imaging evidence suggesting long COVID may damage dopamine-releasing neurons in the brain, potentially explaining persistent fatigue, low motivation, slowed movement and memory difficulties in patients. The finding moves long COVID from functional complaint toward measurable neural mechanism, pointing to diagnostic biomarkers and treatment strategies targeting dopaminergic pathways, and offering a new reference for assessment frameworks in health management of chronic fatigue conditions.
  • 国家卫健委答复：推广家庭医生健康积分，指导配备智能体重秤与可穿戴设备并接入电子健康档案
    NHC Response: Promoting Family-Doctor Health Points and Smart-Scale/Wearable Integration with Electronic Health Records
    国家卫健委在其官网公开对全国人大代表建议的答复，系统披露基层慢性病健康管理新政进展：推广家庭医生签约服务健康行为积分并允许兑换健康服务；指导有需求患者配备智能体重秤、可穿戴智能检测设备，探索将智能终端监测数据上传至居民电子健康档案；同步推进全民健康信息平台建设、检查检验结果跨省互认与电子健康档案向本人开放，为“个人健康画像+风险预警”式闭环健康管理铺路。
    China's National Health Commission publicly released its response to a deputy's recommendation, detailing progress in grassroots chronic-disease health management: promoting health-behavior points within family-doctor contracts redeemable for services; guiding patients who need them to use smart scales and wearable devices, with device data explored for upload into residents' electronic health records; and advancing the national health information platform, cross-province mutual recognition of test results, and personal access to EHRs — paving the way for closed-loop health management built on personal health profiles and risk alerts.

功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • 《自然·代谢》：首个临床研究显示限时进食可改善早期亨廷顿病相关指标
    Nature Metabolism: First clinical study links time-restricted eating to improved markers in early Huntington's disease
    俄勒冈健康与科学大学团队在《自然·代谢》发表首个针对亨廷顿病的限时进食临床研究：20名早期患者将每日进食限制在6—8小时窗口并坚持12周，体重与瘦体重保持稳定，综合统一亨廷顿病评定量表平均改善0.5分（该评分通常每年下降约1分），神经丝轻链平均下降13%，血细胞线粒体活性多项指标改善。团队正筹备更大规模随机对照试验。
    An OHSU-led team published the first clinical study of time-restricted eating in Huntington's disease in Nature Metabolism: 20 early-stage patients limited eating to a 6–8 hour daily window for 12 weeks. They maintained weight and lean mass, improved 0.5 points on the composite UHDRS (which typically declines ~1 point per year), saw neurofilament light fall 13%, and showed improved mitochondrial activity in blood cells. A larger randomized trial is being planned.
  • 中山六院苏明丽团队开发水响应型凝胶，实现粪菌移植72小时结肠超长驻留
    Sun Yat-sen Sixth Affiliated Hospital develops water-responsive hydrogel extending FMT colonic retention beyond 72 hours
    中山大学附属第六医院苏明丽团队联合深圳大学第一附属医院等在《Bioactive Materials》报道水响应型可注射凝胶Alg-NHS@αLA：接触湿润结肠黏膜后迅速原位成胶，湿态黏附强度达72.9千帕，携带粪菌在结肠驻留超72小时；小鼠结肠炎模型中修复紧密连接、驱动巨噬细胞M2极化并恢复短链脂肪酸水平，并已在猪肠镜模型验证，为提升粪菌移植定植效率提供新材料平台。
    A team led by Su Mingli at Sun Yat-sen University's Sixth Affiliated Hospital reported in Bioactive Materials a water-responsive injectable hydrogel (Alg-NHS@αLA) that gels in situ on wet colonic mucosa, achieving 72.9 kPa wet adhesion and over 72 hours of fecal-microbiota retention. In a mouse colitis model it repaired tight junctions, drove M2 macrophage polarization and restored short-chain fatty acids; porcine endoscopic delivery was validated, offering a new materials platform for FMT.
  • 中国疾控中心团队揭示益生菌缓解哮喘新机制：代谢物IAA是关键
    China CDC team reveals probiotic metabolite IAA as key to easing allergic asthma via the gut–lung axis
    中国疾控中心任志鸿、徐建国团队联合山西白求恩医院在《Advanced Science》揭示植物乳植杆菌GUANKE缓解过敏性哮喘的肠-肺轴机制：菌株重塑肠道菌群并恢复色氨酸代谢物吲哚-3-乙酸（IAA）水平，IAA经抑制STAT3-Jag1-Notch4信号轴限制单核前体向肺部树突细胞分化；哮喘患者血清IAA亦显著低于健康人，为不依赖抗生素的微生态干预提供新靶点。
    A China CDC team led by Ren Zhihong and Xu Jianguo, with Shanxi Bethune Hospital, reported in Advanced Science how Lactiplantibacillus plantarum GUANKE eases allergic asthma: the strain remodels gut microbiota and restores tryptophan metabolite indole-3-acetic acid (IAA), which limits monocyte-to-dendritic-cell differentiation via the STAT3–Jag1–Notch4 axis. Asthma patients also showed lower serum IAA, suggesting a microbiome-based, antibiotic-free intervention target.
  • 肠脑轴科普走红：专家提醒菌群与人是“双向调控”，粪菌移植须守安全边界
    Gut–brain axis goes viral: experts stress two-way regulation and safety boundaries for FMT
    “人是被肠胃菌群控制的高达”话题近日引发热议。中山大学附属第六医院陈俊榕表示，肠道菌群与人体是双向调控：菌群经肠脑轴参与食欲、情绪与免疫信号，但大脑认知、激素与环境同样反向塑造菌群。她提醒，粪菌移植须在正规医疗机构开展，健康人无需常规做菌群检测，养护菌群应保证每日25—30克膳食纤维、避免滥用抗生素与盲目“清肠排毒”。
    A viral topic claimed gut microbes 'pilot' the human body. Chen Junrong of Sun Yat-sen University's Sixth Affiliated Hospital clarified that gut microbiota and the body regulate each other: microbes shape appetite, mood and immunity via the gut–brain axis, while cognition, hormones and environment reshape microbes. FMT must be done in licensed institutions; healthy people need no routine microbiome testing; 25–30 g of daily fiber and avoiding antibiotic overuse remain the basics.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • 《柳叶刀·健康长寿》：失眠认知行为疗法可减缓老年人表观遗传衰老速度
    The Lancet Healthy Longevity: CBT-I slows the pace of epigenetic aging in older adults
    UCLA Health团队发表于《柳叶刀·健康长寿》的随机对照试验二次分析显示：近100名60岁以上失眠老人接受失眠认知行为疗法（CBT-I）后，失眠缓解几率约为睡眠教育对照组的3倍，且DunedinPACE表观遗传时钟测得的衰老速度显著放缓，平均每年慢约2%。研究者指出，睡眠是继运动与饮食之后又一个可干预的衰老调节靶点，但结论仍需多中心研究验证。
    A secondary analysis of an RCT published in The Lancet Healthy Longevity found that among nearly 100 adults aged 60+, cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia (CBT-I) tripled the odds of remission versus sleep education and significantly slowed biological aging on the DunedinPACE epigenetic clock — about 2% slower aging per year. Sleep joins exercise and diet as a modifiable target, though multisite replication is needed.
  • 《自然·医学》：绝经血液蛋白组改变映射大脑衰老与痴呆风险，围绝经期成干预窗口
    Nature Medicine: Menopause blood proteomics map to brain aging and dementia risk
    加州大学圣塔芭芭拉分校团队9月22日在《自然·医学》发表血液蛋白组研究：绝经伴随16种蛋白显著升高，涵盖炎症、突触、代谢与阿尔茨海默病相关通路；由此构建的“绝经蛋白组评分”与更快的认知衰退、更高的痴呆风险相关，并在超1.1万人的四个独立队列中获得验证。蛋白变化更多与FSH等激素相关而非实际年龄，提示围绝经期是女性脑健康干预的关键窗口。
    A UC Santa Barbara team reported in Nature Medicine that menopause is accompanied by significant elevations of 16 blood proteins spanning inflammation, synaptic, metabolic and Alzheimer's-related pathways. A 'menopause proteomic score' built from these proteins tracked faster cognitive decline and higher dementia risk across four cohorts totaling 11,000+ participants. Changes tracked hormones like FSH more than age, framing perimenopause as a key window for women's brain health.
  • 第二届国际长寿大会布加勒斯特举行：从衰老生物学走向医学实践
    2nd International Longevity Congress convenes in Bucharest: from aging biology to medical practice
    第二届国际长寿大会9月24日在罗马尼亚布加勒斯特国家图书馆举行，主题为“从科学到医学实践”。西班牙CNIO端粒专家Maria Blasco、哈佛医学院部分细胞重编程研究者、KAUST表观遗传学者Valerio Orlando等来自欧美、以色列、印度与沙特的专家，围绕健康寿命延长、端粒与表观遗传、再生医学及长寿干预的预防、诊断与个性化落地路径展开研讨。
    The 2nd International Longevity Congress opened September 24 in Bucharest under the theme 'From Science to Medical Practice.' Speakers including telomere biologist Maria Blasco (CNIO), Harvard partial-reprogramming researchers and KAUST epigeneticist Valerio Orlando discussed extending healthspan, epigenetics and regenerative medicine, and how to turn aging biology into prevention, diagnostics and personalized interventions.
  • 长寿联合会：康养与长寿正成为酒店与度假投资的核心驱动力
    Global Longevity Federation: wellness and longevity emerge as key drivers of hospitality investment
    全球长寿联合会9月22日刊文指出，康养与长寿正重塑酒店与度假地产投资逻辑：个性化健康体验、医学检测与长寿干预服务被嵌入高端住宿场景，催生“长寿养生度假”新业态。分析认为，把临床级健康管理搬到旅行场景，将成为长寿经济从诊所走向大众消费的重要通道，也为功能医学与精准营养服务提供新的落地入口。
    The Global Longevity Federation reported that wellness and longevity are reshaping hospitality investment: personalized health experiences, medical testing and longevity interventions are being embedded into high-end resorts, creating a new 'longevity hospitality' category. Moving clinic-grade health management into travel settings could bring the longevity economy from clinics to mass consumers, opening new channels for functional medicine and precision nutrition services.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • 重医团队：本土AKK菌干预使2型糖尿病小鼠总胆固醇降49%、甘油三酯降26%
    Chongqing Medical University: native Akkermansia strain cuts total cholesterol 49% and triglycerides 26% in diabetic mice
    重庆医科大学第二附属医院团队在《Journal of Functional Foods》报道，2型糖尿病小鼠经本土AKK菌（Akkermansia muciniphila ONE）干预后，总胆固醇下降49.22%、甘油三酯下降25.87%、高密度脂蛋白升高47.77%，肝脏脂滴明显减少，机制与AMPK/PPAR-α信号通路调控相关。证据仍来自动物实验，但显示AKK菌研究正从肠道屏障走向全身糖脂代谢干预。
    A team at Chongqing Medical University's Second Affiliated Hospital reported in Journal of Functional Foods that in type 2 diabetic mice, supplementation with the native strain Akkermansia muciniphila ONE lowered total cholesterol 49.22% and triglycerides 25.87%, raised HDL 47.77% and reduced hepatic lipid droplets, via AMPK/PPAR-α signaling. Evidence remains preclinical, but shows Akkermansia research expanding from gut barrier toward systemic lipid-glucose metabolism.
  • 《Antioxidants》：老年人多酚摄入越高，轻度认知障碍风险越低
    Antioxidants: higher polyphenol intake linked to lower odds of mild cognitive impairment in older adults
    发表于《Antioxidants》的意大利记忆门诊92名65岁以上老人横断面研究显示：无轻度认知障碍（MCI）者总多酚、类黄酮与木脂素摄入显著更高；总多酚摄入最高四分位组MCI风险较最低组大幅降低（调整后OR=0.08），橙皮素、柚皮素等与认知评分正相关。但多酚摄入与炎症标志物无稳定关联，提示其认知获益未必经由抗炎通路，仍需前瞻性与干预研究确认。
    A cross-sectional study of 92 Italians aged 65+ at a memory clinic, published in Antioxidants, found that those without mild cognitive impairment (MCI) reported significantly higher total polyphenol, flavonoid and lignan intake. The top quartile of total polyphenol intake had far lower odds of MCI (adjusted OR 0.08); hesperetin and naringenin correlated with cognition. No consistent link with inflammatory markers emerged, so benefits may not run through anti-inflammatory pathways; prospective trials are needed.
  • 清华团队 Cell Research：营养不良改变皮肤菌群，气味更招蚊子
    Tsinghua team in Cell Research: malnutrition reshapes skin microbiota, making body odor more attractive to mosquitoes
    清华大学程功、王毛团队在《Cell Research》发表研究：营养不良会重塑皮肤菌群结构，使感染动物体表气味释放更吸引蚊虫，从而加剧蚊媒传播效率。研究把宿主营养状态—皮肤微生物—媒介昆虫行为串成完整通路，提示改善人群营养状况可能间接削弱登革热等蚊媒传染病的传播，为“营养干预+传染病防控”的交叉策略提供新证据。
    A Tsinghua University team led by Cheng Gong and Wang Mao reported in Cell Research that malnutrition reshapes skin microbiota so infected hosts emit odors more attractive to mosquitoes, boosting transmission efficiency. Linking host nutrition, skin microbes and vector behavior in one pathway, the findings suggest improving nutrition could indirectly curb mosquito-borne diseases like dengue — a new cross-strategy of nutrition plus infectious-disease control.
  • Monteloeder 押注代谢健康与口服美容，以循证与个性化驱动增长
    Monteloeder bets on metabolic health and beauty-from-within, driven by evidence and personalization
    西班牙植物原料商Monteloeder近日表示，将把增长重心放在代谢健康与“由内而外美容”两大方向：代谢综合征人群扩大与消费者对口服美容方案接受度提升，正带动相应植物提取物与循证配方需求。公司称将以临床验证与数字化个性化方案为差异化抓手，配合品牌方开发面向血糖、体重与皮肤健康的复合产品线。
    Spanish botanical ingredient maker Monteloeder said its growth will focus on metabolic health and beauty-from-within: expanding metabolic-syndrome populations and rising acceptance of oral beauty solutions are lifting demand for evidence-backed plant extracts. The company plans to differentiate through clinical validation and digital personalization, co-developing product lines targeting blood glucose, weight and skin health.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • 新研究警示老年人维生素D与B12“共缺乏”的叠加健康风险
    Study highlights risks of vitamin D and B12 co-deficiency in the elderly
    NutraIngredients 9月23日报道一项针对老年人的新研究：维生素D与维生素B12“共缺乏”在老年人群并不少见，且可能带来叠加风险——前者关系骨骼肌功能，后者关系神经与造血功能，共缺乏会放大跌倒、贫血与认知下降风险。研究者建议对老年人开展两种营养素的联合筛查并评估联合补充策略，而非单一营养素孤立干预。
    New research covered by NutraIngredients shows vitamin D and vitamin B12 co-deficiency is common in older adults and may compound health risks: vitamin D supports musculoskeletal function while B12 supports nerves and hematopoiesis, so combined deficiency can amplify fall, anemia and cognitive-decline risk. Researchers recommend joint screening and combined supplementation strategies for the elderly rather than isolated single-nutrient interventions.
  • Lifestream：眼-脑双重照护成为眼部补剂创新核心驱动
    Lifestream sees vision–brain dual care as key innovation driver for eye supplements
    新西兰补剂品牌Lifestream接受NutraIngredients采访时称，“视力-大脑双重照护”正成为眼部补剂创新的核心驱动：消费者不再只关注黄斑与干眼，而是把眼健康与认知衰退预防合并考量，叶黄素、玉米黄质与Ω-3等成分的复配需求上升。公司表示，面向老年与高强度屏幕人群的产品线将围绕眼-脑轴做循证与宣称升级。
    New Zealand supplement brand Lifestream told NutraIngredients that vision–brain dual care is becoming the core innovation driver for eye supplements: consumers now consider eye health together with cognitive-decline prevention, lifting demand for combinations of lutein, zeaxanthin and omega-3s. Product lines for seniors and heavy screen users will build evidence and claims around the eye–brain axis, the company said.
  • Mibelle：韩国“由内而外”美容补剂热度延续，循证与可持续成竞争关键
    Mibelle builds on continued popularity of beauty-from-within category in South Korea
    瑞士原料商Mibelle指出，韩国“由内而外”美容补剂市场持续升温：胶原蛋白、神经酰胺、益生菌与抗氧化成分组合的口服美容产品在年轻消费群体中渗透率不断提高。公司认为，韩国市场对“可证明的机制+成分故事”要求更高，品牌与原料商需要在临床数据、递送技术与可持续来源上同时发力，才能在竞争中立足。
    Swiss ingredient supplier Mibelle noted South Korea's beauty-from-within market keeps growing: oral beauty products combining collagen, ceramides, probiotics and antioxidants are gaining traction among younger consumers. The company said Korean consumers demand provable mechanisms and strong ingredient stories, so brands and suppliers must invest in clinical data, delivery technology and sustainable sourcing to stay competitive.
  • Ancient Nutrition 打造“从农场到货架”再生农业补剂供应链
    How Ancient Nutrition is building regenerative supply from farm to shelf
    美国补剂品牌Ancient Nutrition向NutraIngredients介绍其“从农场到货架”的再生农业供应链：通过再生耕作种植补剂原料作物并追溯至具体农场，把土壤健康与成分营养密度关联作为卖点。公司称，再生供应链不仅是ESG叙事，也是应对原料掺假与质量波动的品控手段，未来将扩大自有农场与透明溯源标签的覆盖品类。
    US supplement brand Ancient Nutrition described its 'farm to shelf' regenerative agriculture supply chain to NutraIngredients: growing ingredient crops via regenerative practices, tracing them to specific farms, and linking soil health to nutrient density as a selling point. The company says regenerative supply is not just an ESG story but a quality-control answer to adulteration and ingredient variability, and it will expand owned farms and transparent sourcing labels.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • 央视《新闻联播》：坚持预防为主，甘肃慢病筛查已覆盖440余万人
    CCTV: prevention-first strategy, Gansu chronic disease screening reaches 4.4 million people
    央视《新闻联播》9月22日播出“坚持预防为主 守护全民健康”专题：甘肃慢病与高发癌症筛查专项行动已筛查慢病患者440多万人，新发现96万余人全部纳入健康信息系统随访管理；国家免疫规划可预防疾病扩至16种，HPV疫苗今年纳入国家免疫规划，全国已有520多万名13岁适龄女孩完成首剂接种；儿童青少年“五健”行动把健康关口前移到校园。
    CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo on September 22 highlighted China's prevention-first health strategy: Gansu's chronic disease and cancer screening campaign has covered over 4.4 million people, with 960,000 newly detected patients enrolled in follow-up; the national immunization program now prevents 16 diseases; HPV vaccination was added this year with 5.2+ million 13-year-old girls receiving first doses; and the 'Five Healths' school initiative moves prevention into campuses.
  • 国家卫健委与市场监管总局发布50项食品安全新国标，涉婴幼儿营养补充
    China releases 50 new national food safety standards covering infant nutrition supplements
    国家卫生健康委与市场监管总局近日联合发布50项新食品安全国家标准及修改单，覆盖食品中铅污染控制、婴幼儿及学龄前儿童营养补充、牛乳蛋白等与日常饮食健康密切相关的领域。新标准以防风险、保健康、促发展为导向，细化食品安全全链条管控要求，既是消费者健康权益的重要保障，也为企业合规生产与监管执法提供统一“硬标尺”。
    China's National Health Commission and the State Administration for Market Regulation jointly issued 50 new national food safety standards and amendments, covering lead contamination control, nutrition supplements for infants and preschool children, milk proteins and other diet-related areas. Oriented toward risk prevention, health protection and development, the standards refine whole-chain food safety management and set a unified yardstick for compliance and enforcement.
  • 《孤独症谱系障碍儿童干预康复指南（2026年版）》发布：最佳干预窗口为6岁前
    China releases 2026 guideline for autism intervention and rehabilitation in children: best window is before age six
    国家卫生健康委9月22日公布《孤独症谱系障碍儿童干预康复指南（2026年版）》，明确目前针对孤独症病因和发病机制的特异性治疗方法仍有限，主要干预方法为康复训练，最佳治疗期为6岁前、越早干预效果越好。指南围绕早期筛查、家庭参与、康复机构规范与转介路径给出系统要求，为基层开展儿童心理行为健康服务提供依据。
    China's National Health Commission published the 2026 edition of its intervention and rehabilitation guideline for children with autism spectrum disorder, noting that disease-specific treatments remain limited, rehabilitation training is the mainstay, and the best window is before age six — the earlier the better. The guideline systematizes early screening, family participation, provider standards and referral pathways for grassroots child mental and behavioral health services.
  • AI 重塑健康信息生态，营养品牌面临“信任测试”
    Industry faces trust test as AI reshapes health information
    NutraIngredients 9月23日刊文称，AI正在重塑消费者获取健康与营养信息的方式，营养品牌面临一场“信任测试”：生成式工具放大了伪科学与夸大宣称的传播风险，也带来个性化沟通的新机会。受访行业人士建议，品牌应主动投资循证内容、透明溯源与第三方验证，把“科学可信”作为AI信息生态中的核心竞争资产。
    AI is reshaping how consumers obtain health and nutrition information, and nutrition brands face a trust test: generative tools amplify the spread of pseudoscience and exaggerated claims while creating new opportunities for personalized communication. Industry voices recommend investing in evidence-based content, transparent sourcing and third-party validation, making scientific credibility the core competitive asset in the AI information ecosystem.

功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • 加拿大伦敦启动“粪菌胶囊”治疗神经性厌食症临床试验
    London researchers test fecal microbiota transplant pills as a treatment for anorexia nervosa
    加拿大伦敦健康科学中心研究所、Lawson 研究所与西安大略大学联合启动临床试验，将健康供体的粪菌移植（FMT）胶囊用于 16—35 岁神经性厌食症患者，共 20 人参与。研究将评估菌群干预对免疫状态、认知、情绪、进食渴望与身体意象的影响。研究者指出，厌食症是死亡率最高的精神疾病之一，患者普遍存在肠道菌群紊乱，肠脑轴或成新治疗突破口。
    A new clinical trial launched by London Health Sciences Centre Research Institute, Lawson Research Institute and Western University will test fecal microbiota transplant capsules from healthy donors in 20 patients aged 16-35 with anorexia nervosa. Researchers will assess changes in immunological status, cognition, mood, food cravings and body image. Anorexia has the highest mortality of any psychiatric disorder and patients show disturbed gut microbiomes, making the gut-brain axis a promising therapeutic frontier.
  • 《Gastroenterology》：单株普氏栖粪杆菌 EXL01 有望替代粪菌移植预防艰难梭菌复发
    Gastroenterology: F. prausnitzii EXL01 strain may replace FMT for preventing recurrent C. difficile infection
    《Gastroenterology》（IF 29.7）发表二代益生菌研究：单株普氏栖粪杆菌 F. prausnitzii EXL01 用于预防多次复发的艰难梭菌感染。与依赖他人菌群的传统粪菌移植相比，标准化单株活菌疗法可控性与安全性更高、量产更易，被视为“以菌治菌”路线迈向主流临床的重要节点，或重塑复发性艰难梭菌的治疗格局。
    A study published in Gastroenterology (IF 29.7) reports that the next-generation probiotic Fecalibacterium prausnitzii EXL01, delivered as a single defined strain, can prevent multiple-recurrent Clostridioides difficile infection. Compared with conventional fecal microbiota transplantation, a standardized single-strain live biotherapeutic offers better control, safety and scalability — a milestone for the 'treat with microbes' approach in mainstream clinical care.
  • 北大汪锴团队 Gut 论文：肠道天然共生菌化身“微型药厂”持续缓释治疗分子
    Peking University team in Gut: engineered native gut symbionts act as miniature factories for sustained drug delivery
    北京大学汪锴团队在《Gut》发表工程益生菌研究：通过定植增强技术改造大肠杆菌 Nissle 1917 等天然共生菌株，使其在肠道内长期定植并持续缓释治疗性分子（如 IL-10），在代谢功能障碍与结肠炎模型中显著改善病情。该“一次干预、长效起效”的活体药物策略，为慢性代谢病与肠炎提供了超越传统给药的新范式。
    A Gut study from Peking University's Wang Kai lab shows that engineered native symbionts such as E. coli Nissle 1917, optimized with colonization-enhancement technology, can durably colonize the intestine and continuously release therapeutic molecules such as IL-10, markedly improving metabolic dysfunction and colitis in models. This 'intervene once, act long' live-biotherapeutic strategy offers a new paradigm beyond conventional dosing.
  • 内蒙古农大张和平团队 npj 子刊：益生菌联合饮食干预助肥胖儿童改善 BMI 与尿酸
    Zhang Heping team in npj Biofilms and Microbiomes: probiotic plus diet intervention improves BMI and uric acid in obese children
    张和平团队在《npj Biofilms and Microbiomes》发表随机双盲安慰剂对照试验：112 名肥胖学龄儿童均接受个性化饮食指导，其中一组额外补充动物双歧杆菌乳亚种 ProSci-246，95 人完成 3 个月随访。结果显示益生菌组第 3 个月 BMI 降幅更大，第 2、3 个月血清尿酸水平显著低于对照组，提示“饮食+菌群”联合干预是肥胖代谢管理的可行路径。
    A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial by Zhang Heping's team in npj Biofilms and Microbiomes enrolled 112 school-age children with obesity, all receiving personalized dietary guidance, with one arm additionally supplemented with Bifidobacterium animalis subsp. lactis ProSci-246; 95 participants completed 3 months. The probiotic arm showed larger BMI reduction at month 3 and significantly lower serum uric acid at months 2 and 3, supporting combined diet-microbiota intervention for metabolic management.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • Nature Aging 事后分析：营养充足的适度热量限制可减缓人类表观遗传衰老
    Nature Aging post hoc analysis: adequately nourished moderate caloric restriction slows epigenetic aging in humans
    CALERIE 试验（220 名 21—50 岁健康非肥胖成人，目标两年内热量摄入较基线减少 25% 且营养充足）事后分析显示：热量限制组 DunedinPACE 等表观遗传衰老指标改善，且效果与体重下降幅度并非完全绑定——“少吃不掉秤”也可能在抗衰层面获益。研究者同时强调必须保证蛋白质与微量营养素充足，避免极端节食带来的免疫损害。
    A post hoc analysis of the CALERIE trial (220 healthy non-obese adults aged 21-50 targeting 25% caloric restriction over two years with adequate nutrition) shows improvement in epigenetic aging markers such as DunedinPACE, with effects not fully tied to weight loss — meaning 'eating less without dropping pounds' may still slow aging. Researchers stress maintaining sufficient protein and micronutrients and avoiding extreme restriction that can impair immunity.
  • 补剂抗衰科学盘点：行业叙事从“活得久”转向机制导向循证
    Catching up with healthspan and lifespan supplements: the latest science
    NutraIngredients 发表健康寿命与寿命补剂科学综述：随着对衰老生物机制研究的加速，行业正以更精细的机制证据取代“延长寿命”式的模糊宣称。文章梳理 NAD+ 前体、衰老细胞清除、表观遗传时钟等热点方向的人体证据现状，指出以机制研究支撑健康寿命宣称将成为补剂企业合规与差异化竞争的关键。
    NutraIngredients reviews the latest science on healthspan and lifespan supplements: research on supplementation and aging is advancing quickly, helping to replace vague 'live longer' claims with nuanced statements grounded in biological mechanisms and human evidence. The roundup covers NAD+ precursors, senolytics and epigenetic clocks, noting that mechanism-based substantiation will be key to compliance and differentiation.
  • “浦江科学之问”将衰老的时空异质性列入十大基础科学问题
    Pujiang Science Questions lists the spatiotemporal heterogeneity of aging among ten fundamental science questions
    2026 浦江创新论坛发布首届“浦江科学之问”十大基础科学问题，其中第十问“衰老的时空异质性及其系统性调节机制”直指核心：为何同龄人脏器老化节奏不同、同一机体肝脏与大脑老化速度各异。中国科学院袁钧瑛指出，需以多组学、人工智能计算与多模型验证拆解机制、寻找干预靶点，呼应国家层面支持抗衰老产业的政策布局。
    The first 'Pujiang Science Questions' released at the 2026 Pujiang Innovation Forum lists the spatiotemporal heterogeneity of aging and its systemic regulation among ten fundamental science questions: why organs age at different paces across individuals and within the same body. CAS researcher Yuan Junying emphasizes combining multi-omics, AI computation and multi-model validation to identify mechanisms and intervention targets, aligning with national support for the anti-aging industry.
  • BMJ Medicine：33 万人研究显示停用 GLP-1 后心血管保护迅速消退
    BMJ Medicine: stopping GLP-1 drugs rapidly erases cardiovascular protection in 333,000-veteran study
    华盛顿大学圣路易斯团队分析 333,687 名 2 型糖尿病退伍军人数据（BMJ Medicine）：停用 GLP-1 药物两年后，心梗、卒中与死亡风险比持续用药者高 22%，重新启动治疗仅能恢复部分保护，作者形容为留下“持久疤痕”。约半数用户因费用、副作用或供应问题在数月内停药，研究者强调“持续治疗本身”应被视为一项临床结局。
    A Washington University in St. Louis study of 333,687 veterans with type 2 diabetes, published in BMJ Medicine, found cardiovascular benefit fades fast after stopping GLP-1 therapy: two years off the drugs was associated with 22% higher risk of heart attack, stroke and death versus staying on treatment, and restarting restored only part of the lost protection. With about half of users quitting within months, the authors argue staying on therapy is a clinical outcome in itself.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • 浙大 Cell Host & Microbe：果胶重塑肠道菌表面结构，借 IgA 免疫抵御结肠炎
    Zhejiang University in Cell Host and Microbe: dietary pectin remodels bacterial surfaces to promote IgA-mediated protection from colitis
    浙江大学汪海峰/唐文杰团队在《Cell Host and Microbe》（IF 23.2）发表研究：膳食纤维果胶可重塑共生细菌表面结构，促进肠道 IgA 介导的免疫保护、抵御结肠炎。研究从“饮食成分—菌群修饰—免疫调控”链条为食源性精准干预提供机制依据，也再次印证全谷物与蔬果纤维在肠黏膜免疫中的核心地位。
    A Cell Host and Microbe study from Zhejiang University (Wang Haifeng and Tang Wenjie labs) shows that dietary pectin remodels the surfaces of commensal bacteria to promote IgA-mediated protection from intestinal inflammation. By linking dietary components, microbial modification and immune regulation, the work provides a mechanistic basis for food-based precision interventions and reinforces the central role of fibers in mucosal immunity.
  • 行业观察：Ω-3 的痛点不是“证据不足”，而是“体感不佳”
    Omega-3 doesn't have a proof problem. It has an experience problem.
    NutraIngredients 刊发 CPG Radar CEO Afif Ghannoum 的评论文章：Ω-3 补剂的科学证据已经相当充分，真正制约复购的是消费者缺乏可感知的“服用体验”。作者建议行业借鉴可穿戴设备的即时反馈思路，通过更直观的体感沟通与效果呈现重建消费信任，而非继续单纯堆砌临床数据。
    In a NutraIngredients commentary, CPG Radar CEO Afif Ghannoum argues that omega-3 supplements have robust scientific evidence, and what actually limits repeat purchase is the lack of a perceivable consumer experience. He recommends the industry borrow the instant-feedback playbook of wearables and rebuild trust through tangible, experiential communication rather than piling up more clinical data.
  • 牛肝菌源益生元或可帮助抗生素治疗后肠道菌群恢复
    Mushroom-based porcini prebiotic may help restore gut bacteria after antibiotics
    NutraIngredients 报道一项牛肝菌（porcini）源益生元新研究：其多糖成分在体外与早期模型中显示可促进有益菌增殖，有望用于抗生素治疗后肠道菌群紊乱的修复。研究为蘑菇源膳食纤维开辟差异化赛道，研究团队计划推进人体验证试验，为“抗生素后菌群重建”这一未满足需求提供食源方案。
    NutraIngredients reports on a new porcini mushroom prebiotic study: its polysaccharides promoted beneficial bacterial growth in early models, suggesting potential to restore gut microbiota disrupted by antibiotic treatment. The mushroom-derived fiber opens a differentiated ingredient track, with human validation trials planned for the unmet need of post-antibiotic microbiome recovery.
  • Gut Microbes：嗜酸乳杆菌改善 MASLD 与糖尿病中的肝脏及菌群失调
    Gut Microbes: Lactobacillus acidophilus improves hepatic and microbial dysregulation in MASLD and diabetes
    韩国团队在《Gut Microbes》（IF 15.3）发表嗜酸乳杆菌（Lactobacillus acidophilus）对代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病（MASLD）与糖尿病中肝脏及微生物群失调影响的研究：菌株干预同步改善肝脏代谢异常与菌群结构失衡，为“益生菌—肠肝轴”干预代谢性疾病提供了新的菌株级循证依据。
    A Korean team publishing in Gut Microbes (IF 15.3) examined Lactobacillus acidophilus effects on hepatic and microbial dysregulation in MASLD and diabetes. The strain simultaneously improved liver metabolic abnormalities and microbiota imbalance, adding strain-level evidence for probiotic gut-liver axis interventions in metabolic disease.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • EFSA 首次就 CBD 新型食品给出正面安全意见，行业迎来“转折点”
    'Turning point' for CBD as EFSA publishes first positive safety opinion
    欧洲食品安全局（EFSA）发布首个针对 CBD 新型食品申请的正面安全意见，被业内视为 CBD 食品化的“重大转折点”。此前欧盟 CBD 申请因安全性数据不足长期停滞，此次放行或为后续大量排队申请扫清关键障碍，为欧洲 CBD 补剂与功能食品市场重启增长打开监管通道。
    The European Food Safety Authority has published its first positive safety opinion on a CBD novel food application, which industry calls a 'major turning point'. EU CBD dossiers had long been stalled over insufficient safety data; the green light could clear the path for numerous queued applications and reopen regulatory channels for Europe's CBD supplement and functional food market.
  • 安利与 FTC 达成 2.25 亿美元和解，直营补剂模式面临合规审视
    Amway agrees $225 million settlement with FTC over alleged deceptive business practices
    美国联邦贸易委员会（FTC）宣布与安利（Amway）就涉嫌误导性商业行为达成 2.25 亿美元和解。业内指出，此案将健康宣称的证据标准与经销商话术监管再次推上风口，对全球采用直营/直销模式的营养补剂企业而言是一记合规警钟，宣称管理与渠道培训将成为风控重点。
    The US Federal Trade Commission announced a $225 million settlement with Amway over alleged deceptive business practices. Observers say the case puts health-claim substantiation and distributor speech back under scrutiny, serving as a compliance wake-up call for direct-selling nutrition supplement companies worldwide, where claim governance and channel training become risk priorities.
  • 澳洲超市集体下架磷虾油：环保争议还是销售疲软？
    Krill oil removed from Aussie supermarkets: environmental concern or sales performance?
    NutraIngredients 报道澳洲主要超市陆续将磷虾油产品下架：表面原因指向南极磷虾捕捞对企鹅、鲸类食物链的环境压力，但业内认为品类定位不清与销量下滑同样关键。此事件预示海洋来源补剂将同时面临环保合规与消费教育双重考验，可持续认证或成出海必备门槛。
    Australian supermarkets are removing krill oil products from shelves. The stated driver is concern over Antarctic krill fishing pressures on penguin and whale food chains, but insiders note unclear positioning and declining sales also matter. The episode signals that marine-derived supplements face both environmental compliance and consumer education tests, with sustainability certification becoming a market-entry requirement.
  • Kerry 推出 Bio-K+ 益生菌产品线，押注英国肠道健康市场
    Kerry bets on growing UK gut health market with Bio-K+ launch
    食品配料巨头 Kerry 宣布在英国市场推出 Bio-K+ 活性益生菌产品线，瞄准持续扩张的肠道健康品类。随着消费者对肠脑轴、免疫与代谢健康的关注升温，欧洲肠道健康补剂正从专业渠道走向主流零售，头部厂商加速以自有品牌与并购落子抢占份额。
    Food ingredients giant Kerry has launched its Bio-K+ live probiotic line in the UK, targeting the fast-growing gut health category. As consumer interest in the gut-brain axis, immunity and metabolic health rises, European gut health supplements are moving from specialist channels into mainstream retail, with major players accelerating moves via own brands and acquisitions.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • 苹果被曝研发无屏健康手环，对标 Whoop 与佳明
    Apple reportedly developing screen-less health and fitness band to rival Whoop and Garmin
    财联社援引古尔曼消息：苹果正研发一款无屏幕健康与健身追踪腕带，采用纤薄织物腕带搭配内置传感器计算模块，主打心率等持续监测，借鉴 Whoop、Oura 的专注健康追踪体验，若最终推出预计不早于 2028 年。此前 Whoop 以 101 亿美元估值完成 5.75 亿美元 G 轮融资，“无屏+持续监测”正成为巨头争夺的腕上健康新赛道。
    Citing Mark Gurman, Cailianshe reports Apple is developing a screen-less health and fitness tracker: a thin fabric band with a sensor-laden compute module focused on continuous metrics such as heart rate, drawing on the focused tracking experience of Whoop and Oura, and likely launching no earlier than 2028. Whoop recently raised $575 million at a $10.1 billion valuation, underscoring the screen-less continuous-monitoring race among tech giants.
  • Oura 启动 IPO：前 9 个月营收 12.1 亿美元、同比增长 74%
    Oura kicks off US IPO process: $1.21 billion revenue for first nine months, up 74%
    智能戒指公司 Oura 于 9 月 21 日启动美国 IPO 流程，目标完全稀释估值约 156.2 亿美元，拟以“OURA”登陆纳斯达克；据路透社报道，截至 6 月 30 日的前 9 个月营收 12.1 亿美元、同比增长 74%。其健康雷达、GLP-1 相关健康功能与 Medicare 慢病合作显示，智能戒指正从睡眠监测走向代谢与慢病管理平台。
    Smart ring maker Oura began its US IPO process on September 21 with a target fully diluted valuation of about $15.62 billion, planning to list on Nasdaq as 'OURA'. Reuters cited revenue of $1.21 billion for the nine months ended June 30, up 74% year over year. Health Radar, GLP-1-linked features and Medicare chronic-care collaborations show the category evolving from sleep tracking into a metabolic and chronic disease management platform.
  • CIPRA.ai 与村田制作所合作开发 AI 慢病管理可穿戴设备
    CIPRA.ai partners with Murata on AI-powered wearables for chronic disease management
    数字孪生与 AI 慢病管理公司 CIPRA.ai 宣布与传感器巨头村田制作所合作，共同开发下一代 AI 可穿戴设备：将先进传感技术与 CIPRA.ai 数字孪生平台结合，为慢性病患者提供持续监测与前瞻性个性化洞察，帮助医疗与保险体系减少可避免住院，推动医疗从被动治疗转向预测性、预防性护理。
    CIPRA.ai, a digital-twin and AI chronic disease management company, announced a partnership with sensor giant Murata to develop next-generation AI-enabled wearables. By integrating advanced sensing with CIPRA.ai's digital twin platform, the collaboration aims to deliver continuous monitoring and proactive personalized insights, helping health systems and insurers reduce avoidable hospitalizations and shift care toward prediction and prevention.
  • Counterpoint 预测：全球可穿戴设备 2026—2032 累计营收超 1 万亿美元
    Counterpoint: global wearables to exceed $1 trillion cumulative revenue in 2026-2032
    Counterpoint 报告预计 2026—2032 年全球消费级可穿戴累计营收超 1 万亿美元、年复合增长 12%，智能戒指、吊坠与眼镜增速最快。今秋新品密集落地：OPPO 新表“FatMax 超燃脂”动态计算燃脂区间、苹果心率采样提速至每 5 秒、华为首次将代谢类慢病筛查纳入手表、Oura 引入夜间血压趋势监测——“从通用公式到千人千面”，健康管理正成为可穿戴最稳固的价值锚点。
    Counterpoint projects global consumer wearables will generate over $1 trillion cumulative revenue in 2026-2032 at a 12% CAGR, with smart rings, pendants and glasses growing fastest. This autumn's launches show the trend: OPPO's FatMax dynamic fat-burning zones, Apple's 5-second heart-rate sampling, Huawei bringing metabolic chronic disease screening to watches and Oura adding nocturnal blood pressure trends — health management is becoming wearables' most durable value anchor.
