item.content:encoded:
功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • 江南大学翟齐啸团队：吃对食物拯救受损肠道菌群（Gut Microbes 综述）
    Restore a damaged gut microbiome with the right foods: Jiangnan University review in Gut Microbes
    江南大学翟齐啸团队在《Gut Microbes》发表综述，系统剖析广谱抗生素如何选择性清除产短链脂肪酸菌与次级胆汁酸转化菌，破坏肠道代谢网络，并与肥胖、糖尿病、过敏等远期慢病风险升高相关。团队提出菌群修复应“从喂菌到修境”：高纤维饮食降低肠腔氧化还原电位、地中海饮食以多酚协同抗炎，为残余有益菌创造再生环境，而非简单“空投”外源益生菌。
    A review by Quanqi Zhai's team at Jiangnan University in Gut Microbes details how broad-spectrum antibiotics selectively wipe out short-chain-fatty-acid producers and secondary bile acid converters, disrupting gut metabolic networks and raising long-term risks of obesity, diabetes and allergy. The authors argue restoration should shift from "seeding bacteria to rebuilding the environment": high-fiber diets lower colonic redox potential and Mediterranean-style polyphenols curb inflammation, helping residual beneficial microbes regenerate rather than simply transplanting probiotics.
  • 肠道细菌分解石榴、核桃等食物后产生的天然化合物有助修复肠黏膜
    Natural gut compound from pomegranates and walnuts helps heal the intestinal lining
    肠道细菌在消化石榴、核桃、浆果等食物后会产生一类天然化合物，新研究发现其有助于修复和保护肠黏膜屏障。该发现揭示了炎症通路“意外有益”的一面，为炎症性肠病等以肠道屏障受损为特征的疾病提供了基于膳食—菌群代谢物的潜在干预新思路。
    A natural compound produced by gut bacteria after digesting foods such as pomegranates, walnuts and berries may help repair and protect the intestinal lining, new research shows. The finding reveals a surprising beneficial side of an inflammatory pathway and points to diet-microbiome metabolites as a potential avenue for conditions marked by gut barrier damage, including inflammatory bowel disease.
  • 上中医包春辉团队：靶向肠脑轴，减少内脏脂肪或能预防阿尔茨海默病
    Targeting the gut-brain axis: cutting visceral fat may help prevent Alzheimer's disease
    上海中医药大学包春辉团队在《Current Obesity Reports》发表综述，提出以内脏脂肪为核心的菌群—肠—脑轴模型：内脏脂肪扩张伴随产短链脂肪酸菌减少与促炎菌群富集，肠屏障紧密连接蛋白下调后脂多糖入血，经受损血脑屏障激活胶质细胞，损伤海马与下丘脑。综述强调腰围与腰臀比对认知风险的分层价值优于BMI，减重诱导的内脏脂肪减少与认知改善相关。
    A review from Baobiao Bao's team at Shanghai University of TCM in Current Obesity Reports proposes a visceral-fat-centered microbiota-gut-brain axis model: expanding visceral fat depletes SCFA producers and enriches pro-inflammatory taxa; gut barrier tight-junction proteins fall, letting LPS enter circulation, cross a weakened blood-brain barrier, activate glia and impair the hippocampus and hypothalamus. Waist circumference and waist-to-hip ratio stratify cognitive risk better than BMI, and weight-loss-driven visceral fat reduction tracks cognitive improvement.
  • 菌群移植（FMT）：已确立的证据、待解的问题与未来方向
    Fecal microbiota transplantation: what we know, what we don't, and what's coming
    功能医学从业者Yoon Hang Kim发文系统梳理菌群移植现状：在复发性艰难梭菌感染中已进入标准临床路径，REBYOTA与VOWST两款FDA批准产品可用，核心机制是定植抗力、胆汁酸与短链脂肪酸修复；花生过敏首次人体试验带来概念验证新信号。作者强调FMT是“微生物生态修复疗法”，并非通用益生菌或长寿干预，需严格供体筛选与适应证管理。
    Writing for clinicians, Yoon Hang Kim reviews the state of FMT: it is standard care for recurrent C. difficile infection with two FDA-approved products (REBYOTA, VOWST), working mainly via colonization resistance, bile-acid and SCFA restoration; a first-in-human peanut allergy trial offers a new proof-of-concept signal. He stresses FMT is a "microbial ecosystem restoration therapy" — not a general probiotic or longevity intervention — requiring strict donor screening and indication control.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • 英矽智能rentosertib进入III期：蛋白组衰老时钟验证受试者生物年龄逆转3-4岁
    Insilico's rentosertib advances to Phase III as proteomic aging clocks confirm 3-4 year biological age reversal
    AI制药公司英矽智能的rentosertib取得里程碑进展：42名平均67岁受试者服药四周后，近3000种血浆蛋白发生变化，六套生物年龄模型评估生理年龄普遍年轻3至4岁、最高近6岁；相关蛋白组衰老时钟分析已发表于《自然》。9月10日，全球首个AI生成式药物III期试验GENESIS-IPF-3完成首例患者给药，拟在全国47家中心入组320人。
    Insilico Medicine's AI-designed rentosertib hit a milestone: 42 participants averaging 67 years old showed changes in nearly 3,000 plasma proteins after four weeks, with six biological-age models estimating physiological age reversals of 3-4 years on average and nearly 6 at best; the proteomic aging-clock analysis was published in Nature. On September 10 the first patient was dosed in GENESIS-IPF-3, the first Phase III trial of a generative-AI drug, planning 320 participants across 47 Chinese centers.
  • 晚年期使用司美格鲁肽可延缓衰老、延长老年雌性小鼠寿命
    Late-life semaglutide slows aging and extends lifespan in older female mice
    《自然》最新研究显示，对20月龄（约相当于人类老年）雌性小鼠给予司美格鲁肽，可将中位剩余寿命从742天延长至834天，并改善多项衰老相关指标，提示GLP-1类药物的获益可能超越减重与代谢改善，直接作用于衰老生物学通路。研究者提醒，该结果来自动物模型，人体证据仍缺乏，不能据此将减肥药当作长寿药使用。
    A new Nature study shows semaglutide given to 20-month-old (roughly elderly) female mice extended median remaining lifespan from 742 to 834 days and improved multiple aging markers, suggesting GLP-1 drugs may act on aging biology itself beyond weight loss and metabolic gains. The authors caution the findings are in animals, human evidence is lacking, and weight-loss drugs should not be taken as longevity drugs.
  • Life Biosciences 完成细胞重编程疗法首例患者给药
    Life Biosciences doses first patient with cell-reprogramming therapy
    据CiVL汇总的近30天长寿临床试验动态，Life Biosciences已完成细胞部分重编程疗法（OSK，靶向青光眼/视神经病变）首例患者给药，成为该路线首个进入人体给药的项目；同期Cedars-Sinai长寿试验由N/A升格为I/II期、扩容至60人并新增试验臂。全球活跃长寿临床试验达43项，其中21项正在招募，衰老干预从动物研究加速走向人体验证。
    According to CiVL's roundup of the past 30 days in longevity trials, Life Biosciences has dosed the first patient with a partial cellular reprogramming therapy (OSK, targeting glaucoma/optic neuropathy), the first such candidate to reach human dosing. In parallel, Cedars-Sinai's longevity trial was upgraded to Phase 1/2, expanded to 60 participants and gained a third arm. Forty-three active longevity trials are now tracked, 21 of them recruiting — accelerating the shift from animal work to human validation.
  • 低剂量雷帕霉素令人体皮肤样本衰老细胞减半，720人大规模研究酝酿中
    Low-dose rapamycin halves senescent cells in human skin samples; 720-person study in the works
    长寿临床试验追踪平台CiVL显示，雷帕霉素抗衰证据链快速推进：低剂量雷帕霉素处理使人体面部皮肤样本中的衰老细胞减少约一半；亚利桑那大学正筹备一项面向老年人的720人雷帕霉素大型研究。这是雷帕霉素从动物延寿数据迈向人体组织与临床验证的关键一步，剂量与获益风险比仍是核心议题。
    CiVL's longevity trial tracker shows the rapamycin evidence base moving fast: low-dose rapamycin cut senescent cells by roughly half in human facial skin samples, and the University of Arizona is preparing a 720-person rapamycin study in older adults. It marks a key step from animal lifespan data toward human tissue and clinical validation, with dosing and benefit-risk balance still the core questions.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • TimeShop长寿营养峰会：以本土人群数据为底座开展精准营养干预
    TimeShop longevity nutrition summit: precision nutrition built on local population data
    TimeShop“逆时·新生”2026全球长寿营养峰会在上海举行，提出针对慢性炎症、肠道微生态失衡与细胞代谢衰退三条通路的“肠道微生态+细胞代谢”双靶点精准干预。香港中文大学黄世万教授分享源自中国长寿之乡百岁老人的AKK001菌株，称其在耐胃酸、耐胆汁及抗炎蛋白表达上优于多国菌株；Brian Kennedy解读Ca-AKGd作用机制与最新人体临床证据。
    At TimeShop's 2026 Global Longevity Nutrition Summit in Shanghai, the brand proposed a dual-target "gut microbiota plus cell metabolism" approach to precision nutrition addressing chronic inflammation, dysbiosis and metabolic decline. CUHK's Sai-Wan Wong presented AKK001, a strain from centenarians in a Chinese longevity village reported to outperform multinational strains in acid/bile tolerance and anti-inflammatory protein expression, while Brian Kennedy discussed Ca-AKGd mechanisms and human trial evidence.
  • FrieslandCampina研究：补充DHA或可提升女性运动员红细胞功能与耐力
    FrieslandCampina study: DHA supplementation may boost red blood cell function and endurance in female athletes
    FrieslandCampina资助的新研究显示，补充DHA或能改善女性运动员的红细胞功能并提升耐力表现，为Ω-3脂肪酸在运动营养中的性别差异化应用提供了新证据。研究提示女性运动员对脂肪酸利用与炎症恢复的需求可能与男性不同，按性别与个体状态定制Ω-3摄入策略，正在成为精准营养在运动人群中的新方向。
    New FrieslandCampina-funded research suggests DHA supplementation may improve red blood cell function and support endurance performance in female athletes, adding sex-specific evidence for omega-3s in sports nutrition. The findings hint that women's fatty-acid utilization and recovery needs may differ from men's, making individualized omega-3 strategies an emerging direction for precision nutrition in athletic populations.
  • 央视网：研究发现常吃豆类的人血糖、血脂真的在变好
    CCTV: people who regularly eat beans really do see better blood sugar and lipids
    央视网健康频道科普梳理指出，控“三高”的关键不是“不吃”而是“会吃”：豆类及豆制品富含优质蛋白、不饱和脂肪酸、膳食纤维、钾与大豆异黄酮，有助于改善血糖、降低血脂并保护血管，这也与国家“减油、增豆、加奶”的膳食倡导一致。文章提醒把豆类纳入日常膳食结构，比单纯限制肉类和主食更可持续。
    A CCTV health channel explainer argues the key to managing blood sugar and lipids is eating smarter, not simply eating less: beans and soy products deliver quality protein, unsaturated fatty acids, fiber, potassium and soy isoflavones that help improve glucose and lipid profiles and protect blood vessels, echoing China's "less oil, more beans and dairy" dietary guidance. Incorporating beans into daily meals is more sustainable than blanket restriction of meat and staples.
  • 蒙牛Lc19本土益生菌登上《Cell》：代谢新物质Trp-CA同时影响血糖与体重
    Mengniu's local probiotic strain Lc19 featured in Cell: novel metabolite Trp-CA affects both blood sugar and body weight
    发表于《Cell》的中国科研成果显示，益生菌Lc19能生成全新代谢活性物质Trp-CA，可同时影响血糖与体重。9月20日发布的科普视频走进北大、中国农大与蒙牛研发中心，对话庞艳莉、赵亮、毛跃建等专家，讲述这株源自长寿之乡的菌株历经17年、从2万株中筛选验证的科研历程，为“本土菌株+精准代谢物”的控糖与体重管理路径提供范例。
    A Chinese study published in Cell shows the probiotic strain Lc19 produces a novel bioactive metabolite, Trp-CA, that influences both blood glucose and body weight. A popular-science video released September 20 visits Peking University, China Agricultural University and Mengniu's R&D center, with experts Pang Yanli, Zhao Liang and Mao Yuejian recounting how the strain from a longevity region was validated over 17 years from 20,000 candidates — a template for "local strains plus precision metabolites" in glucose and weight management.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • COSMOS子研究：每日复合维生素两年减缓表观遗传衰老约四个月
    COSMOS substudy: daily multivitamin slows epigenetic aging by about four months over two years
    发表于《自然·医学》的COSMOS随机对照试验分析显示，958名平均70岁的健康老人每日服用复合维生素两年，PCGrimAge与PCPhenoAge两种表观遗传时钟的衰老速度显著减慢，约相当于每年减缓1.4-2.6个月，基线生物年龄大于实际年龄者获益更明显。专家强调效应微小且未在所有时钟上一致，可能仅反映营养缺口的纠正，复合维生素不能替代健康饮食与运动。
    A Nature Medicine analysis of the COSMOS randomized trial found that 958 healthy adults averaging 70 years who took a daily multivitamin for two years showed significantly slower aging on the PCGrimAge and PCPhenoAge epigenetic clocks — roughly 1.4-2.6 months per year — with larger benefits in those whose baseline biological age exceeded chronological age. Experts stress the effect is tiny, inconsistent across clocks, and may simply reflect correcting nutrient gaps; multivitamins cannot replace diet and exercise.
  • 15万人大型综述：钙与维生素D补充剂对多数老年人预防骨折获益甚微
    Major review of 153,000 adults: calcium and vitamin D supplements offer little fracture benefit for most older adults
    一项涵盖超过15.3万名成年人的大型综述发现，钙与维生素D补充剂——无论单独还是联合服用——对大多数老年人预防骨折或跌倒的作用微乎其微。研究挑战了数百万人日常补钙护骨的惯例，提示补剂策略应回归个体化：对确有缺乏或高危人群仍可能获益，而普遍性补充的公共卫生价值有限，均衡膳食与抗阻运动仍居核心。
    A large review covering more than 153,000 adults finds that calcium and vitamin D supplements — alone or combined — offer minimal protection against fractures or falls for most older adults. The finding challenges the routine of mass calcium supplementation for bone health and argues for individualized strategies: those with true deficiency or high risk may still benefit, while population-wide supplementation shows limited public-health value compared with balanced diets and resistance exercise.
  • TimeShop发布新品“轻松镁”：纳米速吸技术切入液态镁赛道
    TimeShop launches "Easy Magnesium" with nano rapid-absorption technology
    在香港TimeShop全球长寿营养峰会上，品牌发布新品“轻松镁”，采用Epsomax-4纳米速吸技术的条装液态镁制剂，针对镁补充普遍存在的吸收难问题。镁参与300余种酶促反应并关联睡眠、压力与糖脂代谢，液态纳米递送成为补镁产品差异化竞争点，也折射出长寿营养品类从单一原料向递送技术升级的趋势。
    At TimeShop's Global Longevity Nutrition Summit in Shanghai, the Hong Kong brand launched "Easy Magnesium," a stick-pack liquid magnesium using Epsomax-4 nano rapid-absorption technology aimed at magnesium's well-known absorption problem. Magnesium participates in over 300 enzymatic reactions tied to sleep, stress and glucose-lipid metabolism, and liquid nano-delivery is becoming a differentiation point — reflecting the longevity-nutrition category's shift from single ingredients to delivery-technology upgrades.
  • 从寿司到补剂：Hexaraphane的大脑健康潜力获关注
    From sushi to supplements: exploring hexaraphane's brain-health potential
    NutraIngredients专访Dr. Wasabi，探讨源自十字花科蔬菜（如芥末、西兰花芽）的稀有硫化物Hexaraphane在大脑健康领域的潜力。作为6-（甲硫基）己基异硫氰酸酯类成分，其相关研究正从食用历史与安全性评估走向认知功能方向的探索，或将成为继萝卜硫素之后功能原料市场的新晋“明星分子”，尚需更多人体证据支持。
    NutraIngredients talks with Dr. Wasabi about hexaraphane, a rare organosulfur compound from cruciferous vegetables such as wasabi and broccoli sprouts, and its brain-health potential. Research on this 6-(methylthio)hexyl isothiocyanate is moving from food-use history and safety evaluation toward cognitive function exploration, positioning it as a potential follow-up to sulforaphane in functional ingredients — though more human evidence is still needed.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • 美国200余家医疗机构联名反对CMS远程监测报销新规
    Over 200 US health organizations push back on CMS remote monitoring policy changes
    据OpenLoop九月数字健康动态汇总，超过200家医疗机构联合敦促美国医保与医疗补助服务中心（CMS）重新考虑拟议中的Medicare变更——新规将限制第三方临床人员参与远程监测服务。行业组织警告，政策若落地可能干扰约100万Medicare受益人的远程照护，农村与安全网医疗机构受冲击最大，远程健康管理商业模式面临政策不确定性。
    OpenLoop's September digital health roundup reports that more than 200 healthcare organizations are urging CMS to reconsider proposed Medicare changes that would limit third-party clinical staff in remote monitoring services. Industry groups warn the policy could disrupt remote care for roughly 1 million Medicare beneficiaries, hitting rural and safety-net providers hardest — underscoring the policy uncertainty facing remote health-management business models.
  • 40年随访研究：中年管好5个指标，活到90岁几率提升5倍
    40-year follow-up study: managing five key metrics in midlife boosts odds of reaching 90 fivefold
    央视网引用一项随访长达40年的大型研究指出，中年是长寿最关键的干预窗口期：管好血压、血糖、血脂、体重与吸烟等5项指标，活到90岁的几率可提升5倍，中年管好这些指标与延寿近11年相关。自带长寿基因者若生活方式紊乱同样难以长寿，健康科学的生活方式可以弥补基因劣势，中年阶段的行为改变回报最高。
    Citing a 40-year follow-up study, CCTV's health channel highlights midlife as the most critical intervention window for longevity: keeping five metrics in check — blood pressure, blood glucose, blood lipids, body weight and smoking — can raise the odds of reaching age 90 fivefold and is associated with nearly 11 extra years of life. Even those with longevity genes lose the advantage with poor lifestyles, and behavioral change in midlife yields the highest returns.
  • 你的体脂秤可能在“骗”你：专家建议把它当趋势监测工具
    Your body-fat scale may be misleading you: experts say treat it as a trend-tracking tool
    央视网报道，同一人用两台不同品牌体脂秤测出的体脂率可相差悬殊（实测37.1%与24%）。专家解释，体脂秤并非直接“称”脂肪，而是先测生物电阻抗、再结合体重等数据用各家算法估算，模型不同结果自然有别。建议把体脂秤作为趋势监测工具，关注两到四周的变化方向而非单次读数的绝对值，健康管理决策应结合腰围、血液指标等综合判断。
    CCTV reports that the same person can register wildly different body-fat readings on two consumer scales (37.1% vs 24% in one test). Experts explain these devices don't measure fat directly: they take bioelectrical impedance and estimate body fat via each brand's proprietary algorithm, so results vary. The advice: use a body-fat scale as a trend tool, watching two-to-four-week direction rather than absolute single readings, and ground health decisions in waist circumference and blood markers.
  • 中国减盐周：面条“藏盐”、标签“缩水”，警惕隐形高盐刺客
    China Salt Reduction Week: hidden salt in noodles and shrinking labels deserve scrutiny
    每年9月15日所在周为中国减盐周，“915”寓意“就要5克”。我国成人日均盐摄入约9.3克，远超5克建议量，高盐升高血压并增加心脑血管病、肾病、骨质疏松、胃癌和肥胖风险。专家提醒警惕挂面、面包等隐形高盐食品与营养成分表的“缩水”标注，善用限盐工具、外卖备注少盐、逐步减量，慢病患者每日建议不超3克。
    The week of September 15 is China's Salt Reduction Week — "915" punning on "just 5 grams." Chinese adults average about 9.3 grams of salt daily, nearly double the 5-gram recommendation, raising risks of hypertension, cardiovascular and kidney disease, osteoporosis, gastric cancer and obesity. Experts urge watching hidden salt in dried noodles and bread, checking nutrition labels, using salt-limiting tools, requesting less salt in takeout and cutting back gradually; chronic-disease patients should stay under 3 grams a day.

功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • 全国首个《口服肠道菌群移植（FMT）胶囊》团体标准发布实施
    China's first group standard for oral FMT capsules officially released
    中国国际经济技术合作促进会正式发布全国首个口服FMT胶囊团体标准，南华大学附属南华医院为主要起草单位之一。标准从供体筛选与管理、菌群活性与纯度量化指标、质量控制与出厂检验，到包装、运输和贮存作出全链条规范，补齐口服FMT长期缺乏统一技术规范的行业短板，为肠菌移植的标准化推广与临床转化扫清关键障碍。
    China's first group standard for oral fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) capsules has been released, with Nanhua Hospital among the lead drafters. It sets end-to-end requirements covering donor screening, quantitative potency and purity indicators, quality control and factory testing, plus packaging, transport and storage — closing a long-standing standardization gap and clearing a key hurdle for the clinical rollout of oral FMT.
  • 功能医学创新大会聚焦肠道微生态精准干预："测-补-养-固"闭环重塑代谢健康管理
    Functional medicine conference spotlights precision gut-microbiome intervention
    功能医学创新大会官网发文指出，超七成国人存在不同程度的肠道健康问题，西湖大学与中山大学联合研究首次揭示2型糖尿病、高血压、血脂异常共享相似的菌群紊乱特征。文章梳理了功能医学"测补养固"四步闭环：先以宏基因组测序明确菌群图谱，再定制益生菌、益生元与后生元方案，并配合饮食与生活方式巩固，推动肠道干预从盲目调理走向精准纠偏。
    A feature from the Functional Medicine Innovation Conference notes that over 70% of Chinese adults have gut-health issues, and joint research by Westlake University and Sun Yat-sen University shows type 2 diabetes, hypertension and dyslipidemia share similar dysbiosis patterns. It outlines a four-step "test–supplement–nurture–consolidate" closed loop combining metagenomic sequencing with tailored pro-, pre- and postbiotics plus diet and lifestyle support.
  • 医生提醒：肠-脑轴前景真实但需专业指导，精神益生菌与FMT不应自行尝试
    Doctors urge caution on the gut-brain axis: psychobiotics and FMT need medical guidance
    TopDoctor杂志刊文提醒，肠-脑轴研究升温的同时，商业菌群检测的方法学与临床价值差异巨大，经医生开具、由验证实验室完成的检测远比直接面向消费者的自测产品可靠。精神益生菌与粪菌移植在难治性抑郁、帕金森病等方向展现出真实潜力，但必须在医生指导下进行；自行处方高剂量益生菌既可能浪费金钱，也可能带来安全风险。
    TopDoctor Magazine cautions that commercial microbiome tests vary widely in methodology and clinical utility, and physician-ordered testing through validated labs is far more meaningful than direct-to-consumer kits. Psychobiotics and FMT show real promise for treatment-resistant depression and Parkinson's disease, but should only be pursued under medical supervision rather than self-prescribed.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • 英矽智能联合巴克研究所、哈佛医学院登Cell封面，开源AI长寿研究发现工具包
    Insilico Medicine opens an AI longevity discovery toolkit on the cover of Cell
    9月17日，英矽智能联合Liquid AI、巴克衰老研究所、哈佛医学院及布莱根等机构在《Cell》发表封面研究，并同步开源一套AI长寿研究发现工具包。该工作将大模型与衰老生物学数据深度结合，用于加速衰老靶点与干预分子的发现，标志着头部AI制药企业正式把长寿科学列为重点方向，为全球抗衰药物研发提供可复用的开源基础设施。
    On September 17, Insilico Medicine, together with Liquid AI, the Buck Institute for Research on Aging and Harvard/Brigham researchers, published a Cell cover paper and open-sourced an AI longevity discovery toolkit. By pairing large models with aging-biology data to accelerate target and molecule discovery, the release marks a leading AI drug-discovery company formally committing to longevity science with reusable open infrastructure.
  • 《自然·通讯》7500人研究：十种健康饮食模式均与更慢的表观遗传衰老相关，没有唯一"最优饮食"
    Ten healthy diets all linked to slower epigenetic aging, Nature Communications study finds
    德国DZNE团队分析约7500名成年人的血液样本与饮食问卷，使用覆盖约85万个DNA位点的三代表观遗传时钟，评估地中海、DASH、MIND、北欧、植物基等10种健康饮食模式。结果显示任何一种高质量饮食均与更慢的生物衰老相关，且70%以上的受益通路在各饮食间共享；吸烟者从健康饮食中获益最大。研究者强调"不需要完美饮食，整体膳食质量才是关键"。
    A DZNE team analyzed blood samples and diet data from about 7,500 adults using epigenetic clocks covering ~850,000 DNA sites, assessing ten healthy patterns including Mediterranean, DASH, MIND and Nordic diets. Every high-quality diet was linked to slower biological aging, with over 70% of affected pathways shared across diets; smokers gained the most. "You don't need a perfect diet," researchers conclude.
  • GeroScience汇总7项热量限制RCT：改善炎症-代谢衰老指标，约半数效应由减重介导
    Pooled analysis of seven caloric-restriction trials shows improved aging biomarkers, half mediated by weight loss
    发表于《GeroScience》的汇总分析纳入7项随机对照热量限制试验、共829名平均约67.5岁的参与者。随机分配至热量限制组可显著改善由CRP、IL-6、胱抑素C、胰岛素、GDF-15等构成的复合炎症-代谢生物标志物指数；校正体重变化后效应量约减弱一半，中介分析提示约48.5%的效应由减重介导——"少吃"并非已被证明的抗衰老处方，仍需结合个体情况评估。
    A pooled analysis in GeroScience of seven randomized caloric-restriction trials (n=829, mean age ~67.5) found that CR improved a composite inflammation–metabolism biomarker index (CRP, IL-6, cystatin C, insulin, GDF-15 and more). Adjusting for weight change roughly halved the effect, and mediation analysis attributed about 48.5% of it to weight loss — "eating less" is not yet a proven anti-aging prescription.
  • 《BMC Geriatrics》多中心RCT：12周含HIIT训练显著改善养老机构老人肌少症功能，握力平均提升9.1公斤
    12-week HIIT-based training markedly improves sarcopenia-related function in care-home residents
    发表于《BMC Geriatrics》的多中心随机对照试验纳入92名疑似肌少症的养老机构老年人。12周多组分训练（含高强度间歇）使握力较对照组平均提高9.11公斤、SPPB提高3.75分、起立行走测试改善7.09秒，握力与SPPB的NNT约为2，干预效率罕见地高；但肌肉量未见显著差异，提示对高龄人群而言，功能改善优先于增肌数字。
    A multicenter RCT in BMC Geriatrics enrolled 92 care-home residents with probable sarcopenia. A 12-week multicomponent program including HIIT raised grip strength by 9.11 kg versus controls, improved SPPB by 3.75 points and chair-stand time by 7.09 seconds, with an NNT of about 2 — remarkably efficient. Muscle mass showed no significant change, suggesting functional gains precede hypertrophy in very old adults.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • 《低GI食品与健康消费产业共识（2026）》发布：低GI是膳食优化工具，不是"反碳水"口号
    China releases 2026 industry consensus on low-GI foods as a dietary optimization tool
    由农业农村部食物与营养发展研究所牵头、21家科研与产业机构专家参与制定的《低GI食品与健康消费产业共识（2026）》于9月20日发布。共识指出我国居民长期以精制谷物为主、慢释放碳水化合物摄入不足，餐后血糖波动推高代谢风险；低GI食品应在中国居民膳食指南的平衡框架内作为补充工具，同时纠正盲目断碳，倡导控制总量、合理搭配与个性化适配。
    The 2026 Low-GI Foods and Healthy Consumption Industry Consensus, led by China's Institute of Food and Nutrition Development with experts from 21 organizations, was released on September 20. It notes that refined-grain-heavy eating and insufficient slow-release carbohydrates drive post-meal glucose swings, positioning low-GI foods as a complement within balanced dietary guidelines while correcting blind carb avoidance in favor of portion control and food pairing.
  • ScienceDaily：全谷物"甜蜜点"找到了——每天4-6份与更好的心脏健康相关
    Scientists find the whole-grain "sweet spot" for heart health: 4–6 servings a day
    一项新研究为全谷物摄入划出了"甜蜜点"：每天约4-6份全谷物与更好的心血管健康指标相关，摄入不足则获益有限，盲目大量增加亦非更优选择。研究提示全谷物通过膳食纤维、B族维生素与多酚等成分的协同作用改善血脂与血管功能，为膳食指南中"粗细搭配"提供了剂量化的科学依据，也提醒公众优先用全谷物替换精制主食。
    New research identifies a whole-grain "sweet spot" of roughly 4–6 servings per day, associated with better cardiovascular health markers. Benefits taper off below that level, and simply adding more is not necessarily better. Fiber, B vitamins and polyphenols likely act together on lipids and vascular function, giving quantitative support for swapping refined staples for whole grains.
  • ScienceDaily：8种常见食品添加剂与高血压、心脏病风险升高相关
    Eight common food additives linked to high blood pressure and heart disease
    一项新研究将加工食品中常见的8种添加剂与高血压和心血管疾病风险联系起来。研究者指出，这些添加剂通常以"复合暴露"的形式被同时摄入，单一成分看似安全剂量的叠加效应可能被长期低估，提示超加工食品的心血管危害部分来自添加剂组合而非任何单一成分。这为"减盐减油减糖"之外进一步控制超加工食品摄入提供了新的循证支撑。
    A new study links eight additives commonly used in processed foods to higher risks of high blood pressure and cardiovascular disease. Because people typically consume them together as "co-exposures," the combined effect of individually safe doses may be underestimated, suggesting part of ultra-processed foods' cardiovascular harm comes from additive combinations rather than any single ingredient.
  • 咖啡樱桃来源的非常规酵母展现益生菌与后生元潜力
    Coffee cherry-derived non-conventional yeasts show probiotic and postbiotic potential
    据《NutraIngredients》报道，一项新研究从咖啡樱桃中分离出多种非常规酵母菌株，实验显示它们具备耐受胃肠消化、黏附肠道上皮等典型益生菌特性，其灭活后的后生元组分亦表现出抗氧化与调节潜力。研究为咖啡加工副产物的高值化利用开辟了新路径，也为功能食品行业提供了传统乳酸菌之外的新一代候选菌株资源。
    New research has isolated non-conventional yeast strains from coffee cherries that survive gastrointestinal digestion and adhere to intestinal epithelium — hallmark probiotic traits — while their heat-inactivated postbiotic fractions show antioxidant and modulatory potential. The work opens a high-value route for coffee processing by-products and adds novel candidate strains beyond traditional lactic acid bacteria.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • 蒙牛两款自研特医食品获批注册，均为国内首款符合新国标品类
    Mengniu wins registration for two first-of-their-kind FSMP products in China
    蒙牛旗下特殊医学营养品牌"特一亿诺"宣布两款自研特医食品获国家市场监管总局批准注册：婴儿氨基酸配方"宁敏瑞"专为0-12月龄食物蛋白过敏婴儿打造，是国内首款符合特医食品新国标的该品类产品；谷氨酰胺组件配方"萱康安"亦为中国首款符合新国标的同类产品。"十五五"健康规划明确鼓励发展特医食品与保健食品，政策与供给端正同步提速。
    Mengniu's medical-nutrition brand has won registration for two self-developed foods for special medical purposes: an amino-acid formula for infants with food-protein allergy and a glutamine component formula, each the first of its kind under China's new FSMP national standards. The approvals follow the 15th Five-Year health plan's explicit encouragement of FSMP and health-food development.
  • NYO3展出LPC系列脑营养新品：纳米级主动递送技术瞄准血脑屏障难题
    NYO3 showcases LPC brain-nutrient line using nano-scale delivery to cross the blood-brain barrier
    2026服贸会期间，NYO3首次公开展出与Aker BioMarine合作的LPC系列脑营养新品。该系列采用LPC纳米级主动递送技术，相关原料拥有7国专利及多项国际安全认证，针对营养成分穿越血脑屏障的递送瓶颈，两款核心产品分别面向脑衰老干预与心脑肝协同养护场景，也反映出脑健康营养的市场竞争正从原料本身转向递送效率。
    At the 2026 CIFTIS, NYO3 publicly unveiled its LPC brain-nutrient line developed with Aker BioMarine. Built on LPC nano-scale active delivery technology with patents in seven countries, the products target the blood-brain-barrier bottleneck in nutrient delivery, with two SKUs aimed at brain aging and combined heart–brain–liver support — a sign that brain-health nutrition competition is shifting from ingredients to delivery efficiency.
  • 美国新法案拟修复"药品排除"条款，为膳食补充剂创新松绑
    New US bill seeks to fix the drug preclusion provision to boost supplement innovation
    美国一项新提出的法案试图修复膳食补充剂监管中的"药品排除"条款——当某种成分已被研究或获批为药物后，其补充剂形式可能被禁止上市，这一机制长期抑制行业对有前景成分的投入。法案希望通过界定触发条件与既有市场保护机制，在药品研发激励与补充剂可及性之间取得平衡，为补剂行业的成分创新扫清制度障碍。
    A newly introduced US bill aims to fix the drug preclusion provision in supplement regulation, under which an ingredient studied or approved as a drug can bar competing supplement forms from the market — a rule long blamed for chilling investment in promising compounds. The bill seeks to balance pharmaceutical R&D incentives with consumer access to supplements.
  • FermBase推出发酵基生产调配物，为益生菌与后生元量产"提速降耗"
    FermBase launches a blend to streamline fermentation-based production
    据NutraIngredients报道，发酵技术公司FermBase发布一款面向发酵基营养原料生产的即用型调配物，旨在简化菌株培养与放大流程、提高批次一致性并降低生产成本。随着后生元、发酵多酚与微生物来源功能原料的需求上升，产业界的注意力正从"筛选新菌株"延伸到"可规模化的生产工艺"，为精准营养产品的稳定供给提供支撑。
    Fermentation firm FermBase has launched a ready-to-use blend designed to streamline cultivation and scale-up for fermentation-derived nutraceutical production, improving batch consistency and cutting costs. As demand grows for postbiotics, fermented polyphenols and microbe-derived actives, the industry focus is expanding from strain discovery to scalable manufacturing.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • 玖治科技与瑞思迈战略合作：AI可穿戴戒指携手临床睡眠巨头打造"监测-干预"闭环
    RingConn and ResMed partner to close the loop between wearable sleep tracking and clinical care
    据中国科学报报道，玖治科技（RingConn）与瑞思迈（ResMed）在上海签署战略合作备忘录，响应《国民健康"十五五"规划》增设睡眠健康门诊、推进数字化主动健康管理的部署。RingConn智能戒指负责心率、血氧与睡眠分期等无感数据采集，瑞思迈依托全球临床治疗与患者管理经验作为"服务出口"，用AI算法把连续监测转化为可执行的个性化睡眠管理建议。
    RingConn and ResMed have signed a strategic memorandum in Shanghai, aligned with China's 15th Five-Year national health plan push for sleep clinics and digital proactive health management. RingConn's smart ring feeds continuous heart-rate, blood-oxygen and sleep-stage data into ResMed's clinical expertise, with AI translating monitoring into actionable personalized sleep management.
  • 全民健康文明生活方式宣传月：防慢病管体重，"主动健康、自我管理"成年度主题
    China's national healthy-lifestyle awareness month puts self-managed health in the spotlight
    2026年9月1日是第20个"全民健康文明生活方式日"，本月宣传主题为"主动健康，自我管理"，围绕"饮食好、运动好、睡眠好"三好促健康，结合三减三健与儿童青少年"五健"科普展开。专家强调超重肥胖不只是外观问题，更是糖尿病、脂肪肝等代谢疾病的关键前置因素，体重管理应从依赖体检报告转向日常微小行为的早关注、早干预、早调整。
    September 1 marked China's 20th National Healthy Lifestyle Day, with this year's theme "proactive health, self-management" promoting good diet, exercise and sleep alongside salt, sugar and oil reduction campaigns. Experts stress that excess weight is a key precursor of diabetes and fatty liver, urging a shift from test-report dependence to early, everyday behavior adjustments.
  • 央视网科普：科学评估健康体重不能只盯着体重秤，BMI、腰围、腰臀比要综合看
    Don't just watch the scale: assess healthy weight with BMI, waist and waist-to-hip ratios
    央视网在"体重管理年"背景下刊发科普，指出单纯以体重数字判断胖瘦并不可靠：BMI需结合腰围与腰臀比综合评估，内脏脂肪堆积比体重数字更能预测代谢风险。科学的体重管理应聚焦腰围变化、体成分与生活方式质量，而非追求短期掉秤，为公众践行"健康体重管理行动"提供了可操作的方法论。
    In the context of China's "Weight Management Year" campaign, CCTV explains that body weight alone is an unreliable gauge: BMI should be interpreted together with waist circumference and waist-to-hip ratio, and visceral fat predicts metabolic risk better than scale weight. Sustainable management should track waistline, body composition and lifestyle quality rather than short-term weight loss.
  • 43年、超13万人队列研究：每天2-3杯含咖啡因咖啡，痴呆风险降低18%
    43-year study of 130,000+: 2–3 cups of caffeinated coffee daily linked to 18% lower dementia risk
    哈佛大学与Mass General Brigham团队基于护士健康研究与健康专业人员随访研究，追踪超13万人长达43年发现：与极少饮用者相比，含咖啡因咖啡摄入量最高者痴呆风险降低18%，每天2-3杯含咖啡因咖啡或1-2杯茶获益最明显，且在痴呆遗传易感人群中同样成立；脱咖啡因咖啡未显示此类关联，提示咖啡因可能在保护效应中扮演关键角色。
    Drawing on the Nurses' Health Study and Health Professionals Follow-Up Study, Harvard and Mass General Brigham researchers tracked over 130,000 people for up to 43 years. Highest caffeinated-coffee intake was associated with an 18% lower dementia risk, peaking at 2–3 cups of coffee or 1–2 cups of tea daily and holding even in genetically susceptible groups; decaffeinated coffee showed no such link.

功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • 丁酸抗炎为何有人无效？天津医大团队找到连接遗传与菌群的「表观遗传刹车」
    Why Butyrate Doesn't Always Work: Tianjin Team Finds the Epigenetic 'Brake' Linking Genetics and Gut Microbes
    天津医科大学吴旭东、孙朝冉团队的研究揭示：肠道菌群代谢物丁酸的抗炎作用，必须依赖宿主巨噬细胞中组蛋白变体 H2A.Z 这一「表观遗传刹车」——灌胃丁酸或定植产丁酸的丁酸梭菌可显著缓解小鼠结肠炎，但在 H2A.Z 条件性敲除小鼠中保护效应全部消失。研究还在炎症性肠病（IBD）全基因组关联数据中锁定 GAS41、TIP60 两个风险位点：携带风险等位者这两种蛋白在单核细胞中表达降低，相当于「刹车片」先天磨损；IBD 患者肠组织中两者表达显著低于健康人，且与疾病活动度及抗 TNF 生物制剂应答不良相关。这为「宿主遗传设定警戒阈值、菌群代谢物维持阈值」的疾病框架提供了证据，也提示基于检查点状态的个性化微生物干预方向。
    Work from Tianjin Medical University (Wu Xudong and Sun Chaoran's teams) shows that the anti-inflammatory effect of the microbial metabolite butyrate depends on an intact host 'epigenetic brake' — the histone variant H2A.Z in macrophages. Oral butyrate or colonization with butyrate-producing C. butyricum significantly eased colitis in mice, but all protection vanished in H2A.Z conditional knockout animals. Mining inflammatory bowel disease genome-wide data, the team pinned two risk loci near GAS41 and TIP60: risk alleles lower their expression in monocytes ('worn brakes'), and IBD patients show lower expression in gut tissue, tied to disease activity and poor anti-TNF response. The study supports a framework where host genetics sets the threshold and microbial metabolites maintain it — pointing toward checkpoint-informed, personalized microbiome interventions.
  • 肠道菌群比出生日期更能反映衰老状态：1199 人研究发现「B2 肠型」与早发炎症相关
    Your Gut May Age Faster Than You: 1,199-Person Study Links the 'B2 Enterotype' to Early-Life Inflammation
    发表于《Nature Communications》、覆盖 1199 名 20—72 岁成人的研究发现：与实际年龄相比，肠道菌群差异与炎症水平、心肺适能和代谢健康等多项健康指标的关联更紧密。其中被称为「B2 肠型」（Bacteroides 2）的菌群模式尤为不利——携带者菌群多样性更低、炎症更高、心肺与代谢指标更差，且在青年期就出现通常见于老年群体的「炎症衰老样表型」：同样的炎症水平，其他菌群组要到约 37 年后才出现。随访最长 9 年显示 B2 与更多健康问题相关、而多样性更高的菌群与更低炎症和疾病风险相关。作者强调这是观察性研究、不能推断因果，但指出「菌群构成原则上可改变」——水果、蔬菜、全谷物与发酵食物仍是可操作的杠杆。
    A Nature Communications study of 1,199 adults aged 20–72 found that differences in gut bacteria tracked more closely with inflammation, cardiorespiratory fitness and metabolic health than chronological age did. One pattern, the 'B2' enterotype (Bacteroides 2), stood out as unfavorable: lower diversity, more inflammation, poorer heart-lung and metabolic measures — and an 'inflammaging-like phenotype already in early adulthood', with inflammation levels other groups only reached about 37 years later. Up to nine years of records linked B2 to more health problems, while higher diversity tracked with less inflammation and disease. The authors stress this is observational and cannot prove causality, but note gut composition is 'in principle modifiable' — fruit, vegetables, whole grains and fermented foods remain the practical levers.
  • 陈卫院士等80余位专家聚焦：人体微生态精准诊疗北京市重点实验室启动
    80-Plus Experts Gather as Beijing Key Lab for Precision Human Microecology Diagnosis and Therapy Launches
    北京大学第三医院举办人体微生态精准诊疗与菌剂研发北京市重点实验室启动会，80余位专家与会。会议确立“机制解析—精准诊断—原创制剂—验证转化”研究主线，覆盖精准诊断、菌剂研发、菌群移植与中药调菌等方向，标志着肠道菌群研究正从“发现关联”走向“精准诊疗”。
    Peking University Third Hospital hosted the launch of a Beijing key laboratory for precision human microecology diagnosis, therapy and microbial agent development, drawing more than 80 experts including academician Chen Wei. The lab sets a research line of mechanism analysis, precision diagnosis, novel microbial agents and translational validation, marking the shift of microbiome research from association findings toward precision diagnosis and intervention.
  • A4M临床课程将启：把菌群科学转化为功能医学实操工具
    A4M Clinical Course to Translate Microbiome Science Into Functional Medicine Practice
    美国抗衰老医学科学院（A4M）将于9月24日至27日在纳什维尔举办“Accelerated Microbiome Insights”临床课程，围绕内毒素/LPS与神经炎症、非纤维益生元、肠-甲状腺轴、中年女性脑健康及菌群驱动的心代谢疾病等议题，为功能医学与整合医学从业者提供菌群评估与干预的实操框架。
    The American Academy of Anti-Aging Medicine (A4M) will hold its Accelerated Microbiome Insights clinical course in Nashville on September 24-27, covering endotoxin/LPS-driven neuroinflammation, non-fiber prebiotics, the gut-thyroid axis, midlife female brain health and microbiome-driven cardiometabolic disease — equipping functional and integrative medicine clinicians with practical frameworks for microbiome assessment and intervention.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • ScienceDaily：恢复下丘脑Menin蛋白，小鼠多项衰老指标被逆转
    Restoring Hypothalamic Protein Menin Reverses Multiple Signs of Aging in Mice
    ScienceDaily 9月18日重点报道：下丘脑Menin蛋白随龄下降可能与驱动全身衰老相关，在小鼠中与炎症、认知衰退、骨量下降和皮肤变薄有关。向20月龄小鼠下丘脑重新导入Menin 30天后，皮肤、骨骼、认知与平衡能力改善并延长寿命；补充D-丝氨酸则可改善认知但不逆转骨骼皮肤变化。
    ScienceDaily highlights research showing that age-related decline of the hypothalamic protein Menin may help drive systemic aging, being linked in mice to inflammation, cognitive decline, bone loss and thinner skin. Re-delivering Menin to the hypothalamus of 20-month-old mice improved skin, bone, cognition and balance within 30 days and extended lifespan, while D-serine supplementation improved cognition without reversing physical aging signs.
  • 菌群初创公司加速深耕长寿赛道
    Microbiome Startups Push Deeper Into Longevity
    NutraIngredients 行业报道称，微生物组初创企业正把业务重心从消化健康扩展到长寿与健康寿命领域，通过工程菌株、后生元与衰老相关生物标志物把菌群科学转化为抗衰产品管线，菌群干预正在成为长寿经济中的新兴支柱赛道。
    An industry report by NutraIngredients notes that microbiome startups are expanding beyond digestive health into longevity and healthspan, converting microbiome science into anti-aging product pipelines through engineered strains, postbiotics and aging-related biomarkers — positioning microbiome intervention as an emerging pillar of the longevity economy.
  • 补剂抗衰科学盘点：健康寿命与寿命研究最新进展一览
    Catching Up With Healthspan and Lifespan Supplement Science: A Roundup of the Latest Research
    NutraIngredients 汇总近期健康寿命与寿命相关补剂科学进展，覆盖细胞健康成分的多成分组合趋势、衰老生物标志物在干预评估中的应用，以及从细胞机制向日常健康寿命产品转化的证据要求，为长寿营养品研发与选品提供循证参考。
    NutraIngredients rounds up recent healthspan and lifespan supplement science, covering the multi-ingredient stack trend in cellular-health products, the use of aging biomarkers to evaluate interventions, and the evidence standards required to translate cellular mechanisms into everyday healthspan products — a reference point for longevity nutrition R&D and product selection.
  • 《2026全球长寿诊所医学干预分级及落地指南》发布，梳理长寿营养新方向
    2026 Global Longevity Clinic Intervention Grading Guide Maps New Directions in Longevity Nutrition
    在第七届时光派国际长寿论坛上，时光派联合弗若斯特沙利文发布中英双语《2026全球长寿诊所医学干预分级及落地指南》。其“营养干预”章节指出，长寿营养正从“原料质量”转向“完整产品质量”，完整产品证据成为竞争重点，并以海洋精粹油（SPMs+纯EPA）等循证实践为典型案例。
    At the 7th Timeshop International Longevity Forum, Timeshop and Frost & Sullivan released the bilingual 2026 Global Longevity Clinic Medical Intervention Grading and Implementation Guide. Its nutrition intervention chapter highlights a shift from raw-material quality to whole-product quality, with complete product evidence as the new competitive focus, citing evidence-based practices such as marine lipid oils combining SPMs and pure EPA.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • 同样的热量，不同的命运：活体人类小肠研究显示「全食物」经 GLP-1 与菌群重组胜过精加工
    Same Calories, Different Fate: Live-Human Small-Intestine Study Shows Whole Foods Win via GLP-1 and Microbial Repatterning
    一项发表于《Nature Communications》、借助鼻肠管对活体人小肠分段采样的研究，首次实时观察人类消化过程中的代谢与微生物动态：研究者配制热量与营养配比完全相同、仅「细胞结构完整性」不同的餐食——破碎细胞（BC）餐与保留完整细胞壁的单细胞/细胞簇（SC/CC）餐。结果显示：BC 餐的淀粉在十二指肠迅速释放、葡萄糖峰值高 3—4 倍，与更强的促胰岛素分泌激素 GIP 相关；完整细胞餐则带来更持久的 GLP-1 与 PYY 释放（与饱腹感和食欲调控相关），且餐后回肠菌群快速重组——口腔来源细菌占比可从空腹约 10% 升至 50%，其丰度变化与短链脂肪酸、氨基酸代谢物及 PYY 分泌显著关联。同等热量下仅改变食物微观结构，就足以改变激素应答与代谢轨迹，为「全食物优于精加工」补上微观机制证据。
    In a Nature Communications study using naso-intestinal sampling to observe the living human small intestine in real time, researchers fed meals identical in calories and macros but differing only in cellular structure — disrupted-cell (BC) versus intact-cell (SC/CC) versions. Starch in the BC meal flooded the duodenum, with glucose peaks 3–4 times higher and a stronger insulinotropic GIP response; intact-cell meals produced more sustained GLP-1 and PYY release (satiety and appetite regulation) and triggered rapid ileal microbiome reorganization, with mouth-derived bacteria rising from about 10% fasting to as much as 50% post-meal, their abundance tracking short-chain fatty acids, amino-acid metabolites and PYY secretion. At equal calories, changing only the food's microstructure was enough to alter hormonal responses and metabolic trajectories — mechanistic support for 'whole foods over ultra-processed'.
  • 黑米与绿米的隐藏健康优势：特殊脂质+更慢消化
    Hidden Health Advantage of Black and Green Rice: Unusual Lipids and Slower Digestion
    ScienceDaily 报道，日本黑米和绿米品种含有不寻常且可能有益的脂质成分，并且可能比普通白米消化得更慢。这一“有色米”组合被视为功能性食品设计中颇具前景的原料方向，为以谷物为基础的血糖友好型主食开发提供了新思路。
    ScienceDaily reports that black and green Japanese rice varieties contain unusual, potentially beneficial fats and may be digested more slowly than ordinary white rice. This combination positions pigmented rice as a promising ingredient for functional food design, offering new ideas for grain-based, blood-sugar-friendly staple foods.
  • 蛋白质来源影响血浆AGEs水平：食物选择或比摄入量更关键
    Protein Source Affects Plasma AGE Markers: Food Choice May Matter More Than Amount
    新研究显示，膳食蛋白质来源会显著影响血浆晚期糖基化终末产物（AGEs）水平——AGEs与衰老、慢性炎症及代谢疾病密切相关。研究提示，在蛋白质摄入量相同的情况下，选择不同蛋白来源可能带来不同的 AGEs 负荷，为精准营养中的蛋白质来源优化提供了依据。
    New research shows that the source of dietary protein significantly affects plasma levels of advanced glycation end products (AGEs), which are closely linked to aging, chronic inflammation and metabolic disease. With protein intake held constant, different protein sources appear to impose different AGE burdens — supporting protein-source optimization as a lever in precision nutrition.
  • 泡菜源益生菌或在肠道结合纳米塑料并助其排出体外
    Kimchi-Derived Probiotic May Bind Nanoplastics in the Gut and Help Flush Them Out
    ScienceDaily 报道，一种源自泡菜的细菌在类肠道环境下能够结合纳米塑料；在小鼠实验中，该益生菌使粪便中检出的纳米塑料量增加一倍以上，提示发酵食品中的微生物或可帮助人体排出纳米塑料，为食品源微塑料暴露的膳食干预提供了全新思路。
    ScienceDaily reports that a kimchi-derived bacterium can bind nanoplastics under gut-like conditions. In mice, the probiotic more than doubled the amount of nanoplastics detected in feces, suggesting that microbes from fermented foods may help the body eliminate nanoplastics — a novel dietary intervention angle against foodborne microplastic exposure.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • 澳大利亚TGA将穿心莲从新注册列表药品中移除
    Australia's TGA Removes Andrographis From Use in New Listed Medicines
    澳大利亚药品管理局（TGA）宣布不再允许穿心莲用于新注册的列表药品，这一常见免疫支持类草药成分面临监管收紧。对出口澳洲的补剂品牌而言，含穿心莲配方的新品上市路径受阻，存量产品的标签与合规审查也将趋严。
    Australia's Therapeutic Goods Administration (TGA) has announced that Andrographis paniculata will no longer be permitted in newly listed medicines, tightening regulation of a common immune-support botanical. Supplement brands selling into Australia face blocked launch paths for new andrographis formulations and stricter label and compliance reviews for existing products.
  • 监管数据：行业行动15年，植物成分掺假仍在上升
    Botanical Adulteration on the Rise Despite 15 Years of Industry Action, Data Suggests
    尽管行业已开展15年的反掺假行动，最新数据仍显示植物成分掺假事件呈上升趋势。报道称供应链压力、原料涨价与检测能力不均是主要驱动，凸显第三方身份鉴定、DNA条形码等溯源技术在补剂质量控制中的必要性。
    Despite 15 years of industry anti-adulteration action, new data shows botanical ingredient adulteration incidents are still rising. Supply chain pressure, raw material price hikes and uneven testing capacity are cited as key drivers, underscoring the need for third-party identity testing and DNA barcoding in supplement quality control.
  • 研究支持HMB在年龄相关肌肉保持中的作用
    Study Backs HMB's Role in Age-Related Muscle Preservation
    新研究为β-羟基-β-甲基丁酸（HMB）在年龄相关肌肉流失（肌少症）管理中的角色提供支持，显示其在维持老年人群肌肉质量与功能方面的潜力，为面向老年营养和健康寿命市场的蛋白辅助成分组合再添证据。
    New research supports the role of beta-hydroxy-beta-methylbutyrate (HMB) in managing age-related muscle loss (sarcopenia), showing potential for preserving muscle mass and function in older adults and adding evidence for HMB in protein-companion ingredient stacks targeting the older-nutrition and healthspan market.
  • 全球补剂监管同步加严：日本 GMP 改革、欧盟限量统一与 FDA 现代化——CRN 呼吁厘清「膳食成分」定义
    Supplement Oversight Tightens Globally: Japan's GMP Push, EU Limits and FDA Modernization — CRN Urges Clarity on 'Dietary Ingredients'
    Leatherhead Food Research（Sagentia）9 月 18 日梳理全球补剂监管趋势：日本在小林红曲事件后加速改革，消费者厅 2026 年 6 月发布中期报告，拟明确补剂定义并对片剂/胶囊/粉剂/液体制品强制 GMP，相关措施预计 2026 年末至 2027 年陆续落地；欧盟继续推进维生素与矿物质统一限量，多成员国将德国 BfR 的风险阈值视为参考模型，公众咨询预计 2026 年三季度启动、统一限量或于 2028 年前后采用；美国 FDA 正重新评估新膳食成分（NDI）的安全评估与通报路径。同期，行业组织 CRN 在公众意见期截止前致函 FDA，呼吁结束「膳食成分」分类混乱、重新审视对合成植物成分的窄化立场，并建议建立公开的三分类清单（DSHEA 前成分/已获批 NDI/豁免成分）。三大市场路径不同、方向一致：对成分安全、制造质量与功效实证的审查全面趋严。
    A 18 September briefing from Leatherhead Food Research (Sagentia) maps tightening supplement regulation worldwide: after the Kobayashi red-yeast-rice incident, Japan's Consumer Affairs Agency proposed in June a clearer supplement definition and mandatory GMP for tablets, capsules, powders and liquids, with measures expected through late 2026–2027; the EU continues work on harmonised vitamin-and-mineral limits, with several member states viewing Germany's BfR thresholds as a model (public consultation expected Q3 2026, adoption around 2028); and the FDA is re-evaluating safety assessment and notification pathways for new dietary ingredients (NDIs). In parallel, the Council for Responsible Nutrition submitted comments before the docket closed, urging the FDA to end confusion over ingredient classifications, reconsider its narrow stance on synthetic botanical ingredients, and publish a public three-category list (pre-DSHEA / successful NDIs / exempt ingredients). Different paths, one direction: stricter scrutiny of ingredient safety, manufacturing quality and substantiation.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • 从“戴个表”到“管健康”：智能穿戴驶入医疗级精细化赛道
    From Wearing a Watch to Managing Health: Smart Wearables Enter the Medical-Grade Precision Era
    新华财经观察指出，全球腕戴设备增速放缓，行业竞争已从硬件参数转向医疗级健康监测能力：SKG腕部心电血压记录仪、华为WATCH D2动态血压、OPPO全周期健康管理等头部产品纷纷对标医疗器械标准打磨传感与算法，AI分析将连续体征数据转化为风险预警，推动腕上设备从数据记录者进化为主动健康助手。
    Xinhua Finance Observer notes that as global wrist-worn device growth slows, competition has shifted from hardware specs to medical-grade health monitoring. Leading products such as SKG's wrist ECG-blood-pressure recorder, Huawei WATCH D2 ambulatory blood pressure and OPPO's full-cycle health management are built to medical device standards, with AI converting continuous vitals into risk alerts — turning wearables from data loggers into proactive health assistants.
  • 司美格鲁肽能改变身体，也能改变生活吗？研究：生活质量改善有限
    Ozempic Can Change Your Body. Can It Change Your Life? Evidence Says the Broader Gains Are Modest
    新研究综述发现，Ozempic等GLP-1药物虽显著改善血糖、体重与心血管健康，但几乎没有证据表明它们同样改善心理健康、就业、婚姻或整体幸福感。研究提示GLP-1类药物对生活质量的“外溢效应”可能远小于其生理获益，慢病管理仍需配套生活方式与心理支持。
    New research finds that while Ozempic and other GLP-1 drugs substantially improve blood sugar, weight and cardiovascular health, there is little evidence they also improve mental health, employment, marriage or overall well-being — suggesting the broader life effects of GLP-1s may be far subtler than their physical benefits, and chronic disease management still requires lifestyle and psychosocial support.
  • 英国专家呼吁食品行业联合守护国民健康
    UK Food Industry Must Band Together to Protect the Health of the Nation, Experts Say
    英国行业专家在讨论中呼吁，食品与营养产业应跨越竞争壁垒联合行动，共同改善国民饮食健康，包括配方改良、负责任营销与公共卫生协作。文章认为，面对肥胖与慢病压力，行业协同将是“食品即健康”议程能否落地的关键。
    UK industry experts have called on the food and nutrition sector to act collectively across competitive boundaries to improve national dietary health, including reformulation, responsible marketing and public-health collaboration. Facing obesity and chronic disease pressures, they argue, industry coordination will be decisive for whether the 'food as health' agenda delivers.
  • 国新办“十五五”发布会：慢病防控转向主动健康，健康素养目标40%
    State Council Briefing Charts Proactive Chronic Disease Prevention for the 15th Five-Year Period, Targets 40% Health Literacy
    9月14日国新办“开局起步‘十五五’”发布会上，国家卫健委主任雷海潮披露：我国居民日均盐摄入约9克、食用油41克，均远超推荐量；三级公立综合医院健康体重管理门诊设置率已超95%；居民健康素养为33.7%，十五五目标力争40%。他强调慢病防控要把健康掌握在自己手里，从以治病为中心转向以健康为中心。
    At the State Council's September 14 briefing on the 15th Five-Year Plan, NHC Minister Lei Haichao revealed that Chinese residents consume about 9 g of salt and 41 g of cooking oil daily, far above recommended levels; over 95% of tertiary public hospitals now run weight-management clinics; and national health literacy stands at 33.7% with a target of 40%. He stressed shifting from treatment-centered to health-centered care and empowering individuals in chronic disease prevention.

功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • 肠道菌代谢物「异油酸」首次被证实可激活 LRH-1 受体，在分子层面打通菌群与全身代谢
    Gut Microbe Metabolite Vaccenic Acid Activates LRH-1, Linking the Microbiome to Whole-Body Metabolism
    德国康斯坦茨大学团队在《EMBO Molecular Medicine》报告，首次找到能被细菌分子直接激活的核受体 LRH-1/NR5A2 配体——反刍动物肠道菌产生的「异油酸」（vaccenic acid）。小鼠实验显示，异油酸可显著降低血糖与血脂并改善脂肪肝，机制是激活 LRH-1 转录因子、抑制炎症。研究者指出，二十多年来 LRH-1 在肠肝中的天然配体一直缺失，此次发现说明菌群失衡会通过缺失这类信号影响全身代谢；而人类经由牛羊肉、乳制品摄入异油酸后，该分子可继续在肠道发挥作用。
    A team at the University of Konstanz, publishing in EMBO Molecular Medicine, identified vaccenic acid — produced by bacteria living in ruminants' guts — as the first bacterial ligand able to directly activate the nuclear receptor LRH-1/NR5A2. In mice, vaccenic acid significantly lowered blood glucose and lipids and improved fatty liver disease, acting by activating LRH-1 and suppressing inflammation. The authors note that the natural ligand for LRH-1 in gut and liver had been missing for over two decades, and that the finding shows how microbiome imbalance acts through the loss of such signals; because humans take up vaccenic acid from red meat and dairy, the molecule can keep exerting effects in the gut.
  • 高脂饮食 16 周重编程肠道菌群，代谢炎症与早期心脏重构同步出现——「肠-心轴」再获证据
    16 Weeks of High-Fat Diet Reprograms the Gut Microbiome Alongside Metabolic Inflammation and Early Cardiac Remodeling
    中国医学科学院阜外医院云南医院团队在《Frontiers in Immunology》发表小鼠研究：16 周高脂饮食在诱发肥胖、胰岛素抵抗、血脂异常与全身炎症的同时，肠道菌群被大幅重编程——促炎的 Escherichia-Shigella、Parasutterella 等增多，产丁酸的 Roseburia 及 Alistipes、Parabacteroides 等保护性菌属减少。功能预测显示兼性厌氧、耐应激、成生物膜、潜在致病等表型富集，与 IL-6、TNF-α、CRP 升高及早期心肌重构同步出现，支持「肠-心轴」通路。研究者强调这是动物实验，人群因果仍待验证，膳食纤维与发酵食物仍是最实际的干预杠杆。
    In a mouse study published in Frontiers in Immunology, researchers at Fuwai Yunnan Cardiovascular Hospital (Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences) found that 16 weeks of a high-fat diet induced obesity, insulin resistance, dyslipidemia and systemic inflammation while substantially reprogramming the gut microbiome: inflammation-associated taxa such as Escherichia-Shigella and Parasutterella bloomed, while protective, butyrate-producing genera including Roseburia, Alistipes and Parabacteroides declined. Functional prediction showed enrichment of facultatively anaerobic, stress-tolerant, biofilm-forming and potentially pathogenic phenotypes, appearing alongside elevated IL-6, TNF-α and CRP and early myocardial remodeling — evidence for a working 'gut-heart axis'. The authors stress this is animal work, human causality is unproven, and fibre and fermented foods remain the most practical levers.
  • 影像正常却长期腰痛？新研究提示「肠道菌群失调」驱动的慢性炎症可能是原因
    Normal Scans but Persistent Back Pain? New Study Points to Gut Dysbiosis-Driven Chronic Inflammation

A 2026 pilot randomised controlled trial in Aging Cell found that spermidine supplementation reduced markers of immune cell senescence in healthy older adults and improved their vaccine responses — older adults typically mount weaker responses because of immunosenescence, with impaired autophagy thought to be one cause. A separate 2026 PLoS One protocol paper describes the REPROGRAM trial, a multi-arm study testing geroprotective compounds including spermidine for resilience to physiological stressors such as surgery and infection. 2026 papers in Frontiers in Aging and Cell Stress suggest spermidine acts on inflammation regulation, mitochondrial function and stress responses simultaneously, and contributes to protection partly by inhibiting ferroptosis. The authors stress the pilot was small and no large RCT has confirmed human lifespan extension — the honest status is 'promising but preliminary'. Richest dietary sources are wheat germ, natto, aged hard cheeses, dried mushrooms and soy products.
  • 尿石素 A 证据盘点：2026 年机制研究确认经 AMPK-mTOR 激活线粒体自噬，人体数据仍属早期
    Urolithin A Evidence Check: 2026 Mechanism Work Confirms AMPK-mTOR-Driven Mitophagy, but Human Data Remain Early
    尿石素 A（urolithin A）由肠道菌代谢石榴、核桃与浆果中的鞣花单宁产生，核心价值在于恢复随年龄下降的线粒体自噬。2026 年发表于《Experimental & Molecular Medicine》的研究确认，尿石素 A 通过 AMPK-mTOR 能量感知轴激活线粒体自噬，并在心衰模型中对心脏重构产生下游影响——属机制证据，来自疾病模型而非健康老龄人群。相较多数长寿成分，尿石素 A 确有早期人体试验：口服可激活线粒体自噬，并在老年人中改善肌肉耐力与线粒体生物标志物，但样本量小、周期短。其心脏健康与阿尔茨海默病获益目前主要停留在实验室与动物数据。作者提示生物利用度是关键——只有约 40% 的人能从食物中高效产生尿石素 A，补充可绕过这一瓶颈，但「安全」不等于「被证明能延缓衰老」。
    Urolithin A is produced by gut bacteria from ellagitannins in pomegranates, walnuts and berries, and its core value lies in restoring age-related decline in mitophagy. A 2026 study in Experimental & Molecular Medicine confirmed that urolithin A activates mitophagy via the AMPK-mTOR energy-sensing axis, with downstream effects on cardiac remodeling in a heart failure model — mechanistic evidence from a disease model rather than healthy ageing adults. Unlike most longevity compounds, urolithin A does have early human trials: oral intake activates mitophagy and improved muscle endurance and mitochondrial biomarkers in older adults, though sample sizes were small and durations short. Benefits for heart health and Alzheimer's disease remain largely preclinical. The author notes bioavailability is key — only about 40% of people produce urolithin A efficiently from food, so supplementation bypasses that bottleneck, but 'safe' is not the same as 'proven to slow ageing'.
  • 2026 长寿补剂循证评级：剂量窗口与「证据成熟度」成为筛选主线
    2026 Longevity Supplement Rankings: Dose Windows and Evidence Maturity Become the Main Screening Criteria
    一份 2026 年长寿补剂循证评级把「机制、药代动力学与临床终点是否指向同一方向」作为核心标准，并对剂量窗口提出警示：亚精胺多数市售胶囊仅 1—2mg，而有效区间似为 3—5mg（奥地利 12 个月 RCT 使用的小麦胚芽提取物为 3.3mg/日，改善主观认知下降人群记忆表现）；非瑟酮的衰老细胞清除机制似呈剂量依赖与脉冲式，建议按月脉冲而非每日服用。尿石素 A 以 500mg/日改善中线成人线粒体基因表达与肌肉耐力，且仅约 40% 人群能高效从食物转化。麦角硫因拥有专属转运体 OCTN1，新加坡队列显示血浆水平较高者 10 年认知下降风险低约 30%。水解胶原肽（I、II 型，5—10g/日）在 26 项 RCT 的荟萃分析中改善骨关节炎疼痛与皮肤弹性。评级的潜台词是：这一品类里「机制说得通」与「人体结局可测」同时成立的成分仍然罕见。
    A 2026 evidence-based ranking of longevity supplements uses as its core criterion whether mechanism, pharmacokinetics and clinical endpoints all point the same way, and flags dose windows: most spermidine capsules deliver only 1–2 mg when the effective range appears to be 3–5 mg (the Austrian 12-month RCT used 3.3 mg/day of wheat-germ extract, improving memory in people with subjective cognitive decline); fisetin's senolytic mechanism appears dose-dependent and pulsatile, favouring a monthly pulse rather than daily dosing. Urolithin A improved mitochondrial gene expression and muscle endurance in middle-aged adults at 500 mg/day, and only about 40% of people convert it efficiently from food. Ergothioneine has its own dedicated transporter OCTN1, and a Singapore cohort linked higher plasma levels to roughly 30% lower risk of cognitive decline over 10 years. Hydrolysed collagen peptides (types I and II, 5–10 g/day) reduced osteoarthritis pain and improved skin elasticity in a meta-analysis of 26 RCTs. The underlying message: ingredients where both plausible mechanism and measurable human outcomes hold remain rare in this category.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • 连续血糖监测进入非糖尿病人群风险分层：CGM 血糖模式与血压、血脂风险相关
    CGM Moves Into Risk Stratification for People Without Diabetes: Glucose Patterns Track With Blood Pressure and Lipid Risk
    波士顿大学 Chobanian & Avedisian 医学院团队在《Diabetes Care》发表研究，分析弗雷明汉心脏研究中约 1,300 名无糖尿病、无心血管疾病参与者的连续血糖监测（CGM）数据，检验平均血糖、血糖变异性与高血糖时段等特征与心血管代谢健康标志物的关系。结果显示：平均血糖越高、血糖超过 140mg/dL 的时间占比越高，与高血压或胆固醇异常风险越高相关。研究者指出，空腹血糖与 HbA1c 只是静态快照，无法反映代谢损害的动态与异质性；而 CGM 有助于刻画个体在血糖谱系上的表型，识别早期或间歇性糖代谢异常及其下游心血管代谢风险。该发现有望影响未来无糖尿病人群的心血管风险分层方式，但仍需更多研究验证。
    A team at Boston University's Chobanian & Avedisian School of Medicine, publishing in Diabetes Care, analysed continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) data from roughly 1,300 Framingham Heart Study participants without diabetes or cardiovascular disease, examining features such as average glucose, glucose variability and time spent above threshold against markers of cardiometabolic health. Higher average glucose and a higher percentage of time above 140 mg/dL were related to greater risk of hypertension or abnormal cholesterol. The researchers note that fasting plasma glucose and HbA1c are static snapshots that fail to capture the dynamic, heterogeneous nature of metabolic impairment, whereas CGM can phenotype individuals across the blood sugar continuum and reveal early or intermittent dysglycemia and its downstream cardiometabolic risks. The finding could inform future cardiovascular risk stratification in people without diabetes, though more studies are needed.
  • 七部门方案将智能可穿戴纳入国家消费布局，2026 年中国可穿戴健康设备市场预计突破 826 亿元
    Seven-Ministry Plan Brings Smart Wearables Into National Consumption Strategy; China's Wearable Health Device Market Set to Top RMB 82.6 Billion in 2026
    中央网信办等七部门联合印发《促进数字化绿色化协同转型发展实施方案（2026—2030年）》，明确「扩大人工智能终端、智能可穿戴等产品供给，支持绿色智能商品消费」，将智能可穿戴设备纳入国家消费战略布局；此前「十五五」规划纲要亦提出有序推动数智技术在辅助诊疗、精准医疗、健康管理、医保服务、养老助残等场景应用。市场侧，中国智能可穿戴健康设备市场规模 2024 年为 615 亿元，2025 年约 707 亿元，预计 2026 年突破 826 亿元；全球可穿戴医疗设备市场 2025 年已达 540 亿美元。值得注意的是用户结构变化：可穿戴医疗设备用户中健康人群占比已达 40%，动态血糖监测 2025 年国内销售额 15.4 亿元、同比增速 45.8%，是传统指尖血糖仪整体增速的 4 倍以上。
    Seven Chinese ministries, led by the Cyberspace Administration of China, jointly issued the Implementation Plan for Promoting Coordinated Digital and Green Transformation (2026–2030), explicitly calling to expand supply of AI terminals and smart wearables and support green smart consumption — placing wearable devices within the national consumption strategy. The earlier 15th Five-Year Plan outline likewise called for orderly deployment of digital and intelligent technology in assisted diagnosis, precision medicine, health management, medical insurance services and elderly/disability care. On the market side, China's smart wearable health device market reached RMB 61.5 billion in 2024, about RMB 70.7 billion in 2025, and is expected to exceed RMB 82.6 billion in 2026; the global wearable medical device market hit USD 54 billion in 2025. Notably, healthy users now make up 40% of wearable medical device users, and China's CGM sales reached RMB 1.54 billion in 2025, up 45.8% year on year — more than four times the growth of the overall traditional fingerstick glucose meter market.
  • AI 原生慢病管理进入美国医保创新模型：Counsel Health 携 Oura 承接 Medicare 慢病人群
    AI-Native Chronic Care Enters a U.S. Medicare Innovation Model as Counsel Health Partners With Oura
    AI 原生初级保健公司 Counsel Health 宣布加入美国医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心（CMS）创新中心的 ACCESS 模型「早期心-肾-代谢（eCKM）」轨道：自 2027 年初起，将面向符合条件的 Medicare 受益人，就高血压、肥胖、高脂血症和/或糖尿病前期，零自付提供 AI 原生慢病管理，覆盖美国几乎所有州。Counsel 与智能戒指厂商 Oura 合作，对同意共享数据的患者，把 Oura App 的连续生理指标洞察接入其医疗 AI 与在诊医生，实现「从健康洞察到医生主导行动」。数据显示，90% 以上 65 岁以上成人患有至少一种慢性病，三分之二以上 Medicare 受益人同时管理多种慢病，而数字健康创新此前并未同等地触达这一人群。Counsel 与 Oura 自 5 月合作以来，见诊会员对就诊体验评分 4.6/5。
    Counsel Health, an AI-native primary care company, announced participation in the early cardio-kidney-metabolic (eCKM) track of the CMS Innovation Center's ACCESS Model. From early 2027 it will deliver AI-native chronic care for hypertension, obesity, hyperlipidaemia and/or prediabetes at no out-of-pocket cost to eligible Medicare beneficiaries across nearly all U.S. states. Counsel is partnering with smart-ring maker Oura: for patients who consent to share data, biometric insights from the Oura App feed into Counsel's medical AI and on-demand board-certified physicians, moving members 'from health insights to physician-led action'. More than 90% of adults aged 65+ live with a chronic condition and over two-thirds of Medicare beneficiaries manage multiple chronic diseases, yet many digital health advances have not reached this population at comparable scale. Since their May partnership, members who saw a physician rated their care experience 4.6 out of 5.
  • 中国香港大学联合团队研发硬币大小的新一代连续血糖监测系统，灵敏度创纪录
    University of Hong Kong Team Develops a Coin-Sized Next-Generation CGM System With Record Sensitivity
    由中国香港大学工程学院与李嘉诚医学院、浙江大学、广州医科大学组成的跨学科团队研发出新一代连续血糖监测（CGM）系统 OECT-CGM。该设备仅硬币大小，核心是「有机电化学晶体管」（OECT）——一种生化信号放大器，可将信噪比显著提升至超越传统电化学传感器，从而提供准确可靠的血糖读数。为减少传统 CGM 需针头皮下插入带来的不适，系统采用微针阵列进行皮下葡萄糖采样，并以黏弹性扩散水凝胶稳定皮肤与设备界面。团队表示，OECT 使集成设备达到创纪录的灵敏度；在大鼠实验中，其性能已与市售 CGM 相当。这代表可穿戴健康技术在「无痛取样 + 高信号质量」方向上的一次实质性推进。
    An interdisciplinary team spanning HKU's Faculty of Engineering and LKS Faculty of Medicine, Zhejiang University and Guangzhou Medical University has developed a next-generation continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) system, OECT-CGM. Coin-sized, its core is an organic electrochemical transistor (OECT) — a biochemical signal amplifier that markedly improves signal-to-noise ratio beyond conventional electrochemical sensors, enabling accurate and reliable glucose readings. To address the discomfort of existing CGMs that require a needle under the skin, the system uses a microneedle array for subcutaneous glucose sampling and a viscoelastic, diffusive hydrogel to stabilise the skin–device interface. The team reports that the OECTs achieve record-high sensitivity in the integrated device, and that performance in rodent tests is comparable to commercially available CGMs — a substantive step toward painless sampling with high signal quality in wearable health technology.

功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • 中国医学救援协会全科医学年会在上海举行：功能医学理念融入全科慢病管理
    Chinese Association of General Practice Annual Meeting in Shanghai: Functional Medicine Integrated into Chronic Disease Management
    中国医学救援协会2026全科医学分会学术年会在上海举行。中国功能医学研究院李绍清博士围绕功能医学与现代医疗展开研讨，探索功能医学理念融入全科慢病管理的实践路径；会议同时交流了氢医学基础研究与哮喘等慢性气道疾病的个体化管理思路，推动前沿技术向基层临床下沉。
    The 2026 annual meeting of the Chinese Association of General Practice (Medical Rescue Association) was held in Shanghai. Dr. Li Shaoqing of the Chinese Institute of Functional Medicine explored how functional medicine concepts can be integrated into general-practice chronic disease management, alongside sessions on hydrogen medicine and individualized airway disease care, pushing frontier approaches into primary care.
  • KETOCOMP真实世界研究：食物基序贯生酮方案助地中海饮食无应答复杂肥胖者减脂23%
    KETOCOMP Real-World Study: Food-Based Sequential Ketogenic Protocol Cuts Fat Mass 23% in Mediterranean Diet Non-Responders
    罗马Gemelli医院临床营养团队发表于Nutrients的KETOCOMP观察研究显示，对低热量地中海饮食无应答的复杂肥胖患者，采用4周食物基生酮（约1200千卡/日）加4周低碳水再引入的医学监督序贯方案后，全流程体重、BMI与脂肪量分别下降7.7%、9.45%与23.1%，为临床营养二线干预提供了可操作的路径。
    The KETOCOMP observational study from Gemelli Hospital's clinical nutrition unit, published in Nutrients, shows that complicated obesity patients non-responsive to a hypocaloric Mediterranean diet achieved 7.7% body weight, 9.45% BMI and 23.1% fat mass reductions across a medically supervised sequence of a 4-week food-based ketogenic phase (~1200 kcal/day) plus 4-week low-carb reintroduction — a workable second-line clinical nutrition pathway.
  • 个体化医学营养治疗12周：2型糖尿病患者血糖与炎症、肠屏障标志物同步改善
    12 Weeks of Individualized Medical Nutrition Therapy Improves Glycemia and Inflammatory, Gut-Barrier Markers in Type 2 Diabetes
    发表于Nutrition的一项随机对照试验纳入46名口服降糖药的2型糖尿病患者，个体化医学营养治疗组每周随访，12周后糖化血红蛋白平均下降1.54个百分点、空腹血糖降约57mg/dL，TNF-α、IL-6及循环zonulin同步下降，提示个体化营养干预的影响或超出血糖范畴；作者强调zonulin证据仍属初步。
    A randomized trial in Nutrition enrolled 46 adults with type 2 diabetes on oral agents; the individualized medical nutrition therapy group with weekly follow-up achieved a mean 1.54-point HbA1c drop and ~57 mg/dL fasting glucose reduction over 12 weeks, with TNF-alpha, IL-6 and circulating zonulin also falling — hinting benefits beyond glucose, though the authors stress the zonulin findings remain preliminary.
  • 谷医堂'九科协同'慢病管理模式：功能医学检测与中医体质辨证数据融合
    Guyitang's 'Nine-Specialty Collaboration' Chronic Disease Model Fuses Functional Medicine Testing with TCM Constitution Profiling
    谷医堂披露其中西协同'九科协同'慢病管理实践：旗下华务星辰实验室开展功能医学、代谢指标与慢病风险检测并提供居家采样，将检验微观数据与中医体质辨证、舌脉信息结合形成量化健康数据库，由医师、营养师、健管师等协同小组动态调整干预方案，线上服务用户累计已突破千万人次。
    Guyitang detailed its integrated 'nine-specialty collaboration' chronic disease model: its Huawu Xingchen lab offers functional medicine, metabolic and chronic disease risk testing with at-home sampling, merging lab data with TCM constitution profiling into a quantified health database, while a physician-dietitian-health coach team dynamically adjusts interventions; its online services have surpassed 10 million cumulative users.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • 第七届时光派国际长寿论坛在沪举行，沙利文《2026全球长寿诊所医学干预分级及落地指南》双语发布
    7th TimePie International Longevity Forum Held in Shanghai; Frost & Sullivan's 2026 Global Longevity Clinic Intervention Grading Guide Released Bilingually
    第七届时光派国际长寿论坛汇聚哈佛医学院、耶鲁、哥伦比亚、新加坡国立等学者与诺华、基因泰克等企业代表，4000余人参会。论坛期间发布的《2026全球长寿诊所医学干预分级及落地指南》系统梳理长寿医学评估体系、干预技术图谱与落地路径，其营养干预章节指出行业正从'原料质量'转向'完整产品质量'竞争。
    The 7th TimePie International Longevity Forum brought together researchers from Harvard Medical School, Yale, Columbia and NUS along with Novartis and Genentech representatives, drawing 4,000+ attendees. The bilingual 2026 Global Longevity Clinic Intervention Grading & Implementation Guide maps assessment systems, intervention technologies and commercialization paths; its nutrition chapter notes a shift from 'raw material quality' to 'complete product evidence' as the competitive frontier.
  • ScienceDaily：调整饮食结构仅4周，老年人生物年龄指标即出现逆转迹象
    ScienceDaily: Older Adults Show Biological Age Reversal Signs After Just 4 Weeks of Dietary Restructuring
    9月15日报道的一项研究显示，改变饮食中脂肪、碳水化合物与动物蛋白平衡的老年人，仅在四周后就表现出生物年龄降低的迹象，其中采用杂食性低脂饮食的参与者效果最强。该结果为'短周期营养干预即可影响表观遗传年龄'提供了新证据，但长期效应与机制仍待更大规模试验验证。
    A study reported on September 15 found that older adults who rebalanced dietary fat, carbohydrate and animal protein showed signs of reduced biological age after only four weeks, with the strongest effects in omnivorous low-fat diet participants. The results add evidence that short-cycle nutritional interventions can shift epigenetic age, though long-term effects need larger trials.
  • iScience：幼年高脂饮食造成的线粒体损伤，成年后可用烟酰胺核苷、α-KG或益生菌部分逆转
    iScience: Early-Life High-Fat Diet Mitochondrial Damage Can Be Partially Reversed in Adulthood with NR, Alpha-KG or Probiotics
    《iScience》最新研究通过多组学分析发现，生命早期高脂饮食会永久性抑制脂肪组织三羧酸循环与氧化磷酸化基因、损伤线粒体功能并持久重塑肠道菌群。研究证实，成年后补充NAD前体烟酰胺核苷、三羧酸循环中间体α-酮戊二酸或特定共生菌，可恢复线粒体氧化还原平衡、提升呼吸能力并延长寿命，为幼年肥胖导致的成年代谢危机提供逆转靶点。
    A new iScience multi-omics study shows early-life high-fat diet exposure durably suppresses TCA cycle and oxidative phosphorylation genes in adipose tissue, impairs mitochondrial bioenergetics and permanently reshapes gut microbiota. In adulthood, supplementing the NAD precursor nicotinamide riboside, the TCA intermediate alpha-ketoglutarate, or specific commensal microbes restored mitochondrial redox balance, improved respiration and extended lifespan — offering reversal targets for metabolic sequelae of childhood obesity.
  • Sabinsa长寿配方研讨会前瞻：四氢姜黄素SIRT1人体证据缺口与衰老替代终点之辩
    Sabinsa Longevity Formulation Webinar Preview: The Tetrahydrocurcuminoid SIRT1 Human Evidence Gap and the Debate Over Aging Surrogate Endpoints
    Nutrition Insight对话Sabinsa欧洲总裁Umar Jan：四氢姜黄素延寿数据源自果蝇Sir2/FOXO机制，直接链接SIRT1的人体临床证据仍属空白；其AMPK激活效力约为姜黄素250倍使通路具生物学合理性，EFSA评定成人安全上限为140mg/日。文章还讨论GrimAge、PhenoAge与IL-6等替代终点的取舍——单一指标皆不可尽信。
    Nutrition Insight spoke with Sabinsa's European president Dr. Umar Jan: tetrahydrocurcuminoid lifespan data come from Drosophila Sir2/FOXO mechanisms, and direct human clinical evidence linking intake to SIRT1 activation remains an open gap; ~250-fold higher AMPK activation potency versus curcumin lends plausibility, while EFSA caps adult intake at 140 mg/day. The piece also weighs GrimAge, PhenoAge and IL-6 as surrogate endpoints — none trustworthy in isolation.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • Nature Chemical Biology：机器学习+机器人自动化设计'纤维-菌株'组合，精准定向产出丁酸
    Nature Chemical Biology: Machine Learning Plus Robotic Automation Designs Fiber-Strain Combos for Targeted Butyrate Production
    杜克大学与华盛顿大学团队将机器学习、贝叶斯优化与机器人自动化结合，经五轮'设计-构建-测试-学习'循环，从万亿级组合中锁定菊粉+普通拟杆菌+产丁酸厌氧杆菌组合，可稳定高产丁酸，并在真实人体粪便样本中复现。该框架表明'膳食纤维'不应视为可互换的单一成分，为精准益生元配方设计提供新范式。
    Duke and University of Washington researchers combined machine learning, Bayesian optimization and robotic automation in five design-build-test-learn rounds to identify — from trillions of possible combos — an inulin + Bacteroides uniformis + Anaerostipes caccae pairing that reliably yields high butyrate, reproduced in real human fecal samples. The framework argues dietary fiber should not be treated as interchangeable, setting a new paradigm for precision prebiotic design.
  • Nutrients肠-皮肤轴综述：菌群代谢物如何介导膳食生物活性物与皮肤衰老
    Nutrients Gut-Skin Axis Review: How Microbial Metabolites Mediate Dietary Bioactives and Skin Aging
    9月16日发表于Nutrients的综述系统梳理肠-皮肤轴：多酚、多糖、类胡萝卜素、益生菌与后生元等膳食生物活性物经菌群生物转化生成的SCFAs、吲哚衍生物、尿石素与胆汁酸衍生物，可能中介氧化应激、炎症、线粒体功能与细胞衰老等皮肤衰老通路；但人群因果证据仍有限，个体菌群代谢能力差异或致干预反应异质。
    A review published September 16 in Nutrients maps the gut-skin axis: dietary bioactives such as polyphenols, polysaccharides and carotenoids are microbially transformed into SCFAs, indole derivatives, urolithins and bile acid metabolites that may mediate oxidative stress, inflammation, mitochondrial function and cellular senescence pathways in skin aging — though human causal evidence remains limited and interindividual metabolic capacity may drive heterogeneous responses.
  • 韩国大型队列锁定内脏脂肪相关菌群：Dorea与青春双歧杆菌经糖原合成通路促脂堆积
    Large Korean Cohort Pinpoints Visceral Fat-Linked Microbes: Dorea and B. adolescentis Drive Fat Accumulation via Glycogen Synthesis Pathway
    9月10日发表于《Experimental & Molecular Medicine》的研究基于韩国健康人群大型队列，首次以脂肪分布视角解析菌群与代谢关联，发现内脏脂肪与Dorea longicatena、青春双歧杆菌主导的糖原合成通路关联最强；小鼠灌胃验证两株菌均可促进体重与脂肪增加并上调肝脏脂肪生成基因，为内脏肥胖的菌群精准干预提供靶点。
    Published September 10 in Experimental & Molecular Medicine, this analysis of a large healthy Korean cohort is among the first to examine fat distribution in microbiome-metabolic associations: visceral fat correlated most strongly with a glycogen synthesis pathway driven by Dorea longicatena and Bifidobacterium adolescentis, and oral gavage of either strain promoted weight and fat gain with hepatic lipogenic gene upregulation in mice — nominating targets for precision anti-visceral-obesity interventions.
  • Frontiers in Nutrition试点试验：IgG引导消除饮食改变偏头痛患者肠道菌群并降低zonulin
    Frontiers in Nutrition Pilot Trial: IgG-Guided Elimination Diet Alters Gut Microbiota and Lowers Zonulin in Migraine Adults
    发表于Frontiers in Nutrition的试点饮食干预试验显示，食物特异性IgG引导的个体化消除饮食12周后，偏头痛患者肠道菌群结构显著改变：双歧杆菌、丁酸球菌等富集而普氏菌减少，血清zonulin由399.5降至253.3pg/mL；双歧杆菌丰度升高与CGRP下降及生活质量改善相关，为菌-肠-脑轴参与偏头痛提供假说生成性线索。
    A pilot dietary intervention trial in Frontiers in Nutrition shows that a 12-week food-specific IgG-guided elimination diet significantly reshaped gut microbiota in migraine adults — enriching Bifidobacterium and Butyricicoccus while reducing Prevotella — and cut serum zonulin from 399.5 to 253.3 pg/mL; rising Bifidobacterium correlated with lower CGRP and better quality of life, generating hypotheses for microbiome-gut-brain involvement in migraine.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • 斯坦福Cell Metabolism RCT：小檗碱使餐后GLP-1提升28%，'天然GLP-1伴侣'有了硬数据
    Stanford Cell Metabolism RCT: Berberine Raises Postprandial GLP-1 by 28%, Giving the 'Natural GLP-1 Companion' Hard Data
    斯坦福大学发表于Cell Metabolism的随机双盲试验纳入214名空腹血糖偏高成人，500mg小檗碱一日三次、16周后餐后GLP-1曲线下面积较安慰剂提升28%（p<0.001），HbA1c降0.4%，且心血管风险标志物TMAO无显著升高；研究者称其通过独立于AMPK的通路刺激肠道L细胞分泌GLP-1。专家提醒仍需重复验证，且生物利用度因人而异。
    A randomized double-blind Stanford trial in Cell Metabolism enrolled 214 adults with elevated fasting glucose: 500 mg berberine HCl three times daily for 16 weeks raised postprandial GLP-1 AUC by 28% vs placebo (p<0.001), cut HbA1c by 0.4%, and showed no significant TMAO elevation; investigators describe an AMPK-independent pathway stimulating intestinal L-cell GLP-1 secretion. Experts urge replication and note variable bioavailability.
  • 麦克马斯特大学最大规模肌酸认知试验：55岁以上成人工作记忆与处理速度显著改善
    McMaster's Largest Creatine Cognition Trial: Significant Working Memory and Processing Speed Gains in Adults 55+
    2026年9月麦克马斯特大学发表的随机对照试验纳入386名55岁以上成人，每日5g一水肌酸干预16周后工作记忆与处理速度较安慰剂组显著改善，是迄今该方向规模最大、最严谨的人体试验，把肌酸从'健身房补剂'进一步推入认知健康与长寿视野；同榜单还点名GLP-1伴侣方案（亮氨酸蛋白+肌酸+甘氨酸镁）与肽类品类监管趋严。
    A September 2026 randomized controlled trial from McMaster University in 386 adults aged 55+ found that 5 g/day creatine monohydrate for 16 weeks produced statistically significant improvements in working memory and processing speed versus placebo — the largest and most rigorous human trial to date, pushing creatine beyond the gym into cognitive health and longevity. The same roundup flags GLP-1 companion stacks (leucine-rich protein, creatine, magnesium glycinate) and tightening FTC scrutiny of peptide products.
  • 美国老龄研究院尿石素A葡萄糖代谢试验启动招募：180名55岁以上成人、8周三盲设计
    NIA Urolithin A Glucose Metabolism Trial Opens Recruitment: 180 Adults 55+, Eight-Week Triple-Masked Design
    美国国家老龄研究院（NIA）NCT06274749试验于9月8日更新为招募中，9月10日在巴尔的摩NIA临床研究单元启动：拟纳入180名55岁以上、BMI≥27的成人，随机接受尿石素A或安慰剂8周，随访含血液/尿液检测与心脏评估，主要完成目标为2027年3月31日，或将为线粒体自噬补剂的代谢获益提供高级别证据。
    The National Institute on Aging updated trial NCT06274749 to Recruiting on September 8, with enrollment starting September 10 at the NIA Clinical Research Unit in Baltimore: 180 adults aged 55+ with BMI ≥27 will be randomized to urolithin A or placebo for eight weeks with blood/urine testing and cardiac assessments; primary completion is targeted for March 31, 2027 — poised to deliver high-level evidence on mitophagy supplement metabolic benefits.
  • Naturmega携SUPRIAX2磷脂键Ω-3亮相SupplySide Global：从'来源与浓度'迈向'脂质设计'
    Naturmega Brings SUPRIAX2 Phospholipid-Bonded Omega-3 to SupplySide Global: From Source and Concentration to Intentional Lipid Design
    Naturmega将在拉斯维加斯SupplySide Global 2026向北美市场首秀SUPRIAX2：其Ruby-O酶法技术将EPA/DHA共价键合至磷脂而非简单混合，每日建议份量提供450mg EPA+DHA，约为传统磷虾油两倍强度且不含贝类、口感中性。公司称Ω-3创新正从'哪里来、多浓'转向'如何设计与递送'，早期临床提示其结构脂或改善Ω-3递送与利用。
    Naturmega will debut SUPRIAX2 to North America at SupplySide Global 2026 in Las Vegas: its Ruby-O enzymatic technology covalently bonds EPA/DHA to phospholipids rather than blending them, delivering 450 mg EPA+DHA per serving — roughly twice conventional krill oil strength — shellfish-free with a neutral profile. The company argues omega-3 innovation is shifting from source and concentration to intentional lipid design, with early clinical work suggesting improved omega-3 delivery and incorporation.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • 苹果重押预防健康生态：健康App重构+Quest Diagnostics 119美元50+项血检+Health Age长寿标签
    Apple Goes All-In on Preventive Health: Redesigned Health App, $119 Quest Diagnostics 50+ Biomarker Panel, and a Health Age Longevity Tab
    9月12日消息，苹果发布整合可穿戴数据、健康记录、实验室检测与AI指导的预防健康生态：新版健康App新增Health Age功能（综合VO2max、心率变异性、睡眠与血检评估'健康年龄'）与Longevity长寿纵向数据标签；美国用户可通过Quest Diagnostics以119美元下单覆盖50多项生物标志物的检测面板，约2000个采血点结果自动回传健康App。
    Reported September 12: Apple unveiled a preventive health ecosystem integrating wearable data, health records, lab testing and AI guidance. The redesigned Health app adds a Health Age feature (combining VO2 max, HRV, sleep and blood biomarkers) and a Longevity tab for longitudinal heart, sleep and movement data; US users can order a $119 Quest Diagnostics panel of 50+ biomarkers, with results from ~2,000 sites flowing automatically into the Health app.
  • 新华社观察服贸会智慧诊疗：AI移动医疗车、AI肝胆超级医生智能体与3.2克健康监测戒指同台
    Xinhua on CIFTIS Smart Healthcare: AI Mobile Clinic Vehicles, an AI Hepatobiliary 'Super Doctor' Agent, and a 3.2-Gram Health Monitoring Ring
    2026年服贸会健康卫生服务专题展区集中展示AI医疗落地场景：AI移动医疗车搭载眼底筛查、心电监测、超声诊断等10项车载AI产品，DR智能体基于400万例本土影像数据全流程自动出报告；AI肝胆超级医生智能体让基层医生获得接近专家水平的诊疗方案；仅3.2克健康监测戒指24小时采集6项生理参数并主动预警，健康管理正从'体检才发现'转向'日常早提醒'。
    The health services zone at CIFTIS 2026 showcased AI healthcare at scale: an AI mobile clinic vehicle carrying 10 onboard AI products including fundus screening and ultrasound, a DR agent built on 4 million local imaging cases that auto-generates reports, an AI hepatobiliary 'super doctor' agent giving primary care near-specialist plans, and a 3.2-gram health ring tracking six parameters around the clock with proactive alerts — shifting chronic disease management from late detection to daily early warning.
  • 三部门联合印发《加快提供优质高效眼健康服务工作方案（2026—2030年）》
    Three Ministries Jointly Issue the 2026–2030 Plan for Accelerating High-Quality Eye Health Services
    国家卫生健康委、国家中医药局、国家疾控局近日联合印发《加快提供优质高效眼健康服务工作方案（2026—2030年）》（国卫医政发〔2026〕22号），部署'十五五'期间眼健康工作。同批产业动态还包括华大营养'益人益方'个性化营养素发布、艾兰得智能制造项目银团贷款签约及四川集中销毁3.2亿元涉老假冒保健品。
    China's National Health Commission, National Administration of TCM and National Disease Control Administration jointly issued the 2026–2030 Plan for Accelerating High-Quality Eye Health Services, setting ophthalmic health priorities for the 15th Five-Year period. Concurrent industry items include BGI Nutrition's launch of personalized 'YiRenYiFang' nutrient products, a syndicated loan for Aland's smart manufacturing project, and the destruction of RMB 320 million in counterfeit supplements targeting seniors in Sichuan.
  • 谁才真正需要心脏钙化扫描？十年6000人研究：中低风险人群获益有限，边缘风险人群最该做
    Who Really Needs a Coronary Calcium Scan? Ten-Year Study of 6,000+ Adults: Limited Value for Many, Greatest Value at Borderline Risk
    9月12日报道的一项覆盖6000多名成年人、随访10年的研究发现，热门的冠状动脉钙化（CAC）扫描对许多人的标准心脏病风险评估几乎没有额外价值；但对于处于边缘或中等风险的患者，该扫描可能显著改变风险分层与干预决策。研究提示CAC筛查应更精准地瞄准'不确定地带'人群，而非无差别推广。
    A ten-year study reported September 12 covering more than 6,000 adults found that the popular coronary artery calcium (CAC) scan adds little to standard heart disease risk assessment for many people — but for patients at borderline or intermediate risk it may meaningfully change risk stratification and intervention decisions, suggesting CAC screening should be targeted at the 'uncertain zone' population rather than promoted indiscriminately.

功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • 国家卫健委答复全国人大代表：健全适老食品供给体系，推进老年营养标准与社区营养干预
    NHC Replies to NPC Deputies: Improve the Senior-Friendly Food Supply System, Advance Elderly Nutrition Standards and Community Nutrition Interventions
    卫健委明确将统筹推进老年营养标准体系建设，已发布《老年营养补充食品》国标及《老年人膳食指导》《老年人营养不良风险评估》等行业标准，并推动适老食品深度融入社区养老服务体系，开展老年营养改善专项行动与科普，引导市场主体研发适配老年人生理特点的营养健康食品。
    The National Health Commission said it will coordinate the development of an elderly nutrition standards system. It has already issued the national standard for "Nutritional Supplementary Foods for the Elderly" along with industry standards such as "Dietary Guidance for the Elderly" and "Malnutrition Risk Assessment for the Elderly." It will further integrate senior-friendly foods into community eldercare services, run dedicated elderly nutrition improvement campaigns and public education, and guide market players toward nutritional health foods adapted to older adults' physiology.
  • 青岛大学 Gut Microbes：纤维素拟杆菌-2HPAA 经 PPARγ-CD36 轴改善 MASLD
    Qingdao University in Gut Microbes: Bacteroides cellulosilyticus and 2HPAA Improve MASLD via the PPARγ–CD36 Axis
    研究团队证实纤维素拟杆菌（Bacteroides cellulosilyticus）及其代谢产物 2-羟基苯乙酸（2HPAA）通过 PPARγ-CD36 通路双重调控肝脏脂代谢，减轻肝细胞脂质蓄积、改善 MASLD；并依托 42 名受试者 30 天远洋航行纵向队列验证极端环境应激下调该菌、诱发代谢紊乱，为营养干预与防护策略提供理论支撑。
    The team showed that Bacteroides cellulosilyticus and its metabolite 2-hydroxyphenylacetic acid (2HPAA) dually regulate hepatic lipid metabolism through the PPARγ–CD36 pathway, reducing lipid accumulation in hepatocytes and improving MASLD. A 30-day longitudinal cohort of 42 subjects on an ocean voyage further verified that extreme environmental stress down-regulates this bacterium and induces metabolic disturbance, providing a theoretical basis for nutritional intervention and protective strategies.
  • Frontiers in Nutrition：老年心血管代谢健康「肠道菌群-炎症衰老轴」与膳食干预策略综述
    Frontiers in Nutrition: The Gut Microbiota–Inflammaging Axis and Dietary Strategies in Cardiometabolic Health of Older Adults
    综述系统梳理「肠道菌群-炎症衰老轴」在老年心血管代谢疾病中的作用：随龄有益菌（双歧杆菌、普拉梭菌）减少、促炎菌扩张导致肠漏与代谢内毒素血症，驱动胰岛素抵抗与血管损伤；地中海/绿色地中海/植物基饮食与间歇性禁食可重塑菌群、降低炎症基调，并探讨基于个体菌群的精准营养与下一代益生菌等转化路径。
    The review systematically examines the gut microbiota–inflammaging axis in cardiometabolic disease among older adults: age-related depletion of beneficial bacteria (Bifidobacterium, Faecalibacterium prausnitzii) and expansion of pro-inflammatory taxa cause gut permeability and metabolic endotoxemia, driving insulin resistance and vascular injury.
